digests.summary: Aaj ki digest mein GST refunds aur exemption pe sarkari clarification, Income Tax penalty pe Delhi HC ka order aur LLP compliance ki due date hai. Abhi action lene wale points niche diye gaye hain.

items.headline: GST Refunds: Sarkari Clarifications After 57th Council Meet
items.detail: Finance Ministry ne GST refund process pe major reforms bataye hain jaise fast acknowledgment, 90% automatic provisional refund, late payment pe interest, minimum Rs.1,000 refund limit aur naya ITC refund system. Yeh 57th GST Council ke baad announce hua hai.
items.cga_view: Apne pending GST refund claims ka status check karo aur naye process ke hisaab se update raho. Interest ka benefit lene ke liye timely application file karo.

items.headline: Coffee Curing GST Exemption Only Cultivators Ko Milegi: FinMin
items.detail: Finance Ministry ne clarify kiya hai ki coffee curing pe proposed GST exemption sirf cultivators ko milegi, roasting ya aur processing covered nahi hain.
items.cga_view: Agar aap coffee curing service provider ho, to exemption sirf cultivator-related services pe lagegi, roasting ke bill alag maintain karo.

items.headline: Section 270A IT Penalty Pending ITAT Appeal Par Nahi Lagegi: Delhi HC
items.detail: Delhi High Court ne bola, jab tak ITAT me assessment appeal pending hai tab tak Section 270A ki penalty nahi lagayi jaa sakti. Section 275(1)(a) cite hua hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapki quantum appeal ITAT me hai aur penalty notice mila hai to AO ko Section 275 cite karke penalty ko abeyance me daalne ke liye likho.

items.headline: LLP Form 8 Filing ki Due Date 30 Oct 2026 Hai
items.detail: LLP Form 8 ki last date 30 October 2026 hai for FY 2025-26. Time pe na file ki to late fees aur penalty lag sakti hai. Requirements aur procedure MCA portal pe hai.
items.cga_view: Aapke LLP ka Form 8 abhi tak file nahi hua hai to turant prepare karwa lo, warna heavy late fees lagegi.

due_dates.what: LLP Form 8 filing due date for FY 2025-26

digests.summary: Kuch naye GST ITC proposals discuss ho rahe hain aur Income Tax mein 80P deduction par 3 alag ITAT rulings aa chuki hain. Sab kuch abhi trade source ke basis par hai, official notification ka intezar hai.

items.headline: RCM self-invoice ab e-invoice system mein possible
items.detail: GSTN ne reverse charge mechanism (RCM) ke liye self-invoice e-invoice system mein add kar diya hai, lekin yeh abhi sirf ek facility hai, mandatory nahi. Iska use karna hai ya nahi, yeh abhi business par chhoda gaya hai.
items.cga_view: Filhal is feature ko test karke dekhein, lekin abhi apne RCM invoice compliance process ko badalna zaroori nahi hai. Official notification ka intezar karein.

items.headline: Health/life insurance ITC par GST Council ne proposal discuss kiya
items.detail: Trade reports ke hisaab se, GST Council group health/life insurance ki ITC eligibility relax karne ka proposal discuss kar raha hai (Section 17(5)). Abhi official notification nahi aayi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aap employees ke liye group health/life insurance dete hain, toh possible ITC benefit ke liye latest government notification ka intezar karein. Filhal koi process ya accounting change mat karein.

items.headline: Section 80P deduction: CPC ko belated ITR par disallow ka adhikar nahi
items.detail: Teen ITAT benches (Rajkot, Lucknow, Mumbai) ne alag-alag orders mein bola ki AY 2019-20 ya April 2021 se pehle ki belated ITRs par Section 80P ka deduction CPC adjustment se disallow nahi kiya ja sakta. Sab judgments abhi specific facts par hain.
items.cga_view: Agar aap cooperative society hain aur CPC ne 80P deduction reject kiya hai belated ITR par, toh apni details legal advisor ke saath verify karein – appeal ka scope ho sakta hai. Sabhi cases specific facts dependent hain.

digests.summary: Aaj zyada updates court/tribunal rulings par hain, khaas taur par Income Tax aur GST compliance mein. Official govt release se koi fresh update nahi hai.

items.headline: E-way bill expiry due to breakdown: No penalty
items.detail: Allahabad HC ne GST detention aur penalty quash ki, jab truck breakdown ki wajah se e-way bill expire hua aur tax evasion ka koi evidence nahi mila.
items.cga_view: Agar genuine vehicle issue ho toh bhi documents aur breakdown ka proof ready rakho – unnecessary penalty se bach sakte ho.

items.headline: Onward sale during transit? E-way bill ab bhi zaroori
items.detail: GSTAT ne clarify kiya: Transit mein goods ki onward sale ke baad bhi, sahi e-way bill bana rehna chahiye jo asli movement, origin aur destination ko dikhata ho.
items.cga_view: Onward sale karte waqt e-way bill details zaroor update karo, warna hefty penalty lag sakti hai.

items.headline: Route deviation ke liye GST penalty nahi
items.detail: GSTAT ruling: Sirf route change, valid e-way bill aur proper invoice ke saath, GST penalty justify nahi karta jab tak clear intention to evade nahi dikhe.
items.cga_view: Route change ki info aur valid documents rakhna zaroori hai, lekin galti se penalty se bach sakte ho.

items.headline: Belated GST payment — Interest & penalty must
items.detail: GSTAT: Agar GST short-paid tax ki payment notice ke 30 din ke andar nahi hoti, to interest aur penalty section 73(9) ke under mandatory hai, chahe baad mein payment kari ho.
items.cga_view: Late GST payment mein penalty aur interest fix hai – timely payment par focus rakho, SCN ke 30 din ke andar hi clear karo.

digests.summary: Aaj ki digest mein GST aur Income Tax ke upar latest compliance aur kuch important tribunal rulings hain. Tax audit ki last date bhi yaad rakhna.

items.headline: Tax Audit Report Due 21 October - Last Minute Checklist
items.detail: Tax Audit Report file karne ki last tareekh 21 October 2026 hai, jaisa latest CBDT order ke hisaab se alag-alag assessee par lagu hota hai. Form 3CA un logon par lagta hai jinke accounts pehle se audit ho chuke hain.
items.cga_view: Jis client ke accounts audit ho chuke hain, Form 3CA lagayen. Deadline miss mat karo, penalty lag sakti hai. Sab kuch proof ke saath file karein.

items.headline: Automatic GST Registration Cancellation Process - FAQs by CBIC
items.detail: CBIC ke FAQs ke mutabik, kuch GST registration cancellation applications system dwara automatically process hongi. Rs 2.5 lakh ITC limit aur kisi-kisi conditions apply hongi; cancelled registration ko restore bhi kiya ja sakta hai.
items.cga_view: Agar business closure ya other reason se cancellation dalna hai, nayi auto-processing aur ITC rules ko samjho. Official notification ka intezaar karein for detailed steps.

items.headline: 18% GST Packaging Pe, Tea Pe 5%—Refund Ho Sakta Hai: GSTAT
items.detail: GSTAT ne decide kiya hai ki 18% GST packaging material (tea ke liye) par diya, jab tea khud 5% pe taxed hai, toh inverted duty ka refund section 54(3)(ii) ke under eligible hai.
items.cga_view: Tea industry wale apna ITC calculation dubara check karein aur agar inverted duty hai toh timely refund claim karein. Old cases bhi dikh sakte hain.

items.headline: Assessment of Deceased Invalid—Fresh Notice to Legal Heir: ITAT Raipur
items.detail: ITAT Raipur ne bola, deceased taxpayer ki assessment null thi; ab legal heirs ko procedure follow karke fresh assessment milegi. Section 159(2) refer kiya gaya hai.
items.cga_view: Agar kisi client ke death ke baad assessment notice aayi hai, legal heir hi ab answerable hain. Purane assessment agar galat hue toh relief mil sakta hai.

items.headline: Belated ITR Par Bhi Section 11 Exemption Mil Sakta Hai: ITAT Kolkata
items.detail: ITAT Kolkata ke mutabik, charitable trust ne time se baad ITR file ki fir bhi Section 11 exemption mila, CBDT guidelines follow ki gayi.
items.cga_view: Agar koi charitable trust late ITR file kar chuka hai, exemption ka claim valid ho sakta hai—appeal karne par precedent hai.

items.headline: GSTR-3B vs 2A/2B ITC Mismatch Par Penalty Nahi Lag Sakti: GSTAT
items.detail: GSTAT ne bola, sirf ITC mismatch (GSTR-3B aur 2A/2B) ya wrong ITC head ki wajah se section 74 proceeding nahi start ki ja sakti, jab tak fraud/purposeful suppression nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke client par sirf data mismatch ke base par penalty notice aaye, toh GSTAT ruling ka reference dein. Sirf clerical mistake par heavy action nahi hona chahiye.

digests.summary: Aaj ke digest mein GST par kayi important judicial orders aur ek naye e-invoice feature ki khabar hai. Official notification ka intezaar hai, filhaal saari updates trade sources se hain.

items.headline: GSTAT ne ITC demand GSTR-2A aur 3B mismatch par set aside ki
items.detail: Tribunal ne clarify kiya ki agar IGST credit ka surplus hai, toh usse CGST/SGST shortfall adjust ho sakta hai. ITC demand tabhi banti hai jab poora reconciliation ho.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka ITC mismatch notice aaye, toh poora ITC calculation alag-alag heads mein check karo aur surplus ko consider karwana mat bhulo.

items.headline: E-invoice facility ab RCM self-invoices ke liye [testing mode]
items.detail: GSTN ne e-invoice ka naya supply type start kiya hai jo reverse charge self-invoices aur import of services pe bhi apply hoga. Rollout date abhi announce nahi hui.
items.cga_view: Jo log RCM ki self-invoices banate hain (₹5 crore+ turnover), woh ab e-invoice portal pe testing kar sakte hain. Official rollout ka wait karo, tab mandatory hoga.

items.headline: Kerala HC: Multiple years ko ek GST SCN dena invalid
items.detail: Kerala High Court ne bola ki alag-alag saal ke liye ek hi show cause notice valid nahi hai. Department ko alag-alag years ka notice dena hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko GST notice aaya hai jo kai saal cover karta hai, toh is order ka reference de sakte ho. Composite SCN ko challenge ki possibility hai.

items.headline: GSTR-3B mein galti se extra IGST bhar diya, refund mil sakta hai
items.detail: Tribunal ne bola ki clerical error ki wajah se exporter ko refund deny nahi kar sakte, lower authorities ko actual claim aur customs data dhyan se dekhna chahiye.
items.cga_view: Agar galti se excess IGST pay ho gaya hai, toh refund ka claim proper proof ke saath dubara dalo, authorities ko data clarify karo.

items.headline: GSTAT: Homebuyer ko GST refund mil sakta hai, COVID period exclude hoga
items.detail: Cancelled flat booking par GST refund ke liye COVID wala time period (March 2020–Feb 2022) limitation calculation mein include nahi hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne COVID period mein refund file nahi kiya tha toh ab bhi try kar sakte ho provided aapka claim eligible hai.

items.headline: Unaccounted stock pe direct confiscation nahi ho sakti: GSTAT
items.detail: Inspection mein agar unaccounted goods milte hain toh pehle assessment (tax calculation) under section 73/74 karni hai, direct confiscation section 130 mein nahi chalega.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke premises pe inventory mismatch/raid hui ho, toh demand ka notice assessment se aaye toh hi confiscation possible hai, bina tax determination ke nahi.

digests.summary: Aaj High Courts ne GST ITC aur refund par taxpayer-friendly judgments diye hain. Kuch important Income Tax aur GST court cases bhi highlight kiye gaye hain.

items.headline: GST ITC Mismatch Orders Quashed for Ignoring Circulars
items.detail: Madras HC ne GST ITC mismatch orders cancel kiye kyunki officers ne CBIC circulars follow nahi kiye—jaise supplier ya CA certificate mangna. Officer ko proper process follow karna zaroori hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke against ITC mismatch order hai, official circulars ka reference dena mat bhooliye. Proper documentation ready rakhiye.

items.headline: GST E-Way Bill Glitch? Big Penalty Quashed by Allahabad HC
items.detail: Allahabad HC ne ₹30.63 lakh ka GST penalty hata diya jab e-way bill galti se expire ho gaya aur taxpayer ki koi galat niyat nahi thi.
items.cga_view: Technical glitches hone par department ko likhit explanation ke sath approach karein. Penalty lagne par court order ka reference de sakte hain.

items.headline: GST Refund Mil Sakta Hai, Even If Input/Output Rate Same
items.detail: Punjab & Haryana HC ne decide kiya ki sirf isliye GST refund deny nahi kiya jaa sakta kyunki principal input aur output par same tax rate hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka refund reject hua aise logic se, to court order dikhakar reconsideration ke liye application daalen.

items.headline: Double Taxed GST Turnover? Rectifiable Hai: Madras HC
items.detail: Madras High Court ka maana hai ki agar alag units ke kaaran turnover pe double GST lag gaya, to usko rectify karwaya jaa sakta hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aap pe similar double taxation ka case bana hai, rectification ke liye application file karein—yeh court order support karta hai.

items.headline: GST ITC Mismatch Order Quashed for Ignoring Reconciliation
items.detail: Karnataka HC ne GST order cancel kar diya kyunki officer ne taxpayer ke GSTR-2A aur GSTR-3B reconciliation properly consider nahi kiye.
items.cga_view: ITC mismatch ka notice aaye, to apna reconciliation ready rakhke explain karein. Order galat lag raha ho toh court approach kiya ja sakta hai.

items.headline: Foreign Bank Ko Domestic Tax Rate Ka Benefit Nahi: Calcutta HC
items.detail: Calcutta HC ne foreign bank ko tax rate relief aur head office interest deduction par TDS ke bina manna kar diya.
items.cga_view: Foreign establishments ko apne tax structure aur TDS compliance par dobara review karna chahiye—yeh ruling adverse hai.

digests.summary: Aaj mostly GST aur Income Tax ke kuch important court rulings aaye hain. Compliance aur litigation se jude huye businesses ko details par dhyan dena chahiye.

items.headline: GST Notice Auditor Staff Email Par – Karnataka HC Ruling
items.detail: Karnataka High Court ne kaha ki agar GST notice auditor ke staff email par gaya aur taxpayer sunwai miss kar gaya, toh taxpayer ko dobara mauka milna chahiye GSTR-3B aur GSTR-7 ka reconciliation dene ka.
items.cga_view: Aap apne GST portal aur registered email par notices regularly check karo, aur auditor ki email ID update karna na bhoolo.

items.headline: Bombay HC: GST Appeal Pre-Deposit Shortfall Par Dismissal Pehle Notice Zaroori
items.detail: Bombay HC ne bola ki GST appeal agar pre-deposit mein shortfall ho toh dismiss karne se pehle defect memo ya notice dena mandatory hai.
items.cga_view: Agar GST appeal kar rahe ho toh pre-deposit calculation acche se check karo aur koi notice aaye toh turant response file karo.

items.headline: Section 14A Disallowance Tabhi Jab Exempt Income Ho: ITAT
items.detail: Hyderabad ITAT ne ₹3.60 crore ka Section 14A disallowance hataya kyunki assessee ne exempt income earn hi nahi ki thi. Finance Act 2022 ki amendment ko prospective maana.
items.cga_view: Agar aap exempt income nahi kama rahe ho toh generally Section 14A ka disallowance applicable nahi hoga, lekin recent years ki assessment check karo.

items.headline: Limitation Appeal u/s 62 NCLAT: Date of Order se Shuru
items.detail: Supreme Court ne decide kiya ki NCLAT order ke against limitation period order ki date se count hoga, certified copy milne ka wait nahi karna.
items.cga_view: Agar NCLAT order aapke khilaaf hai toh appeal file karne mein deri na karo, certified copy ka intezaar mat karo.

digests.summary: Aaj mainly GST aur Income Tax par important court rulings aaye hain. Taxpayers ko apne compliance responses detail me tayyar karne chahiye, aur old notices par bhi nazar rakhni chahiye.

items.headline: Unfinalised audit report par GST notice quashed: Kerala HC
items.detail: Kerala HC ne premature GST show cause notice ko khatam kiya hai, unfinalised audit report par, aur taxpayer ke objections Rule 101(4) ke tahat consider karne ko bola hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko provisional ya incomplete audit report basis par notice mile to detailed objection file karen. Court ne yahi favor diya hai.

items.headline: GSTR-2A mismatch se hi galat ITC nahi maan sakte: GSTAT Lucknow
items.detail: GSTAT Lucknow ne bola ki sirf return mismatch (GSTR-2A) se galat ITC claim prove nahi hota. CA certificate bad mein bhi submit ho to maan sakte hain.
items.cga_view: Agar apka ITC sirf 2A mismatch ki wajah se reject ho raha ho, to apne CA se verification karwa kar document submit karein. Apni purchase ki genuineness dikhana zaroori hai.

items.headline: 50 km ke andar Part B E-Way Bill jaruri nahi: GSTAT Ghaziabad
items.detail: GSTAT Ghaziabad ne penalty ko cancel kiya, kyunki initial 50 km movement ke liye Part B bharna required nahi tha - Rule 138(3) exception.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka goods ka initial transport 50 km se kam hai to Part B fill na karne par penalty nahi lagni chahiye. Par next movement ke liye check karein.

items.headline: Penalty for Education Cess deduction deleted: ITAT Mumbai
items.detail: ITAT Mumbai ne Section 270A ki penalty hata di, kyunki education cess aur GST late fee deduction prevailing HC ruling ke basis par genuine maana gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne pehle education cess deduction claim kiya tha to penalty ka dar na rahein. Lekin naye return file karte samay recent CBDT clarification follow karein.

items.headline: Foreign Banks non-discrimination clause: Calcutta HC ruling
items.detail: Calcutta HC ne decide kiya ki foreign banks India mein 'domestic' tax rates nahi le sakte under non-discrimination clause, par kuch deductions allow huye.
items.cga_view: Foreign banks branches India mein operate kar rahe ho to alag tax rates aur restriction ka dhyan rakhein - planning accordingly karein.

digests.summary: Aaj ka digest court rulings aur GST compliance updates pe focused hai. Business owners GST-ITR matching, ITC documentation, aur due process pe dhyan dein.

items.headline: GSTR-9C aur ITR turnover mismatch, agency sales gini nahi jayengi
items.detail: ITAT ne kaha, sirf GST-ITR mein turnover mismatch ki wajah se books reject nahi kiye ja sakte jab agency sales properly reconcile ho jayein aur accounts mein koi gadbad na ho.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka business agency sales karta hai toh turnover calculation pe clarity rakhein; mismatches ka logical explanation paperwork mein ready rakhein.

items.headline: IGST Input Credit: Sirf Supplier Certificate nahi chalega
items.detail: GSTAT Raipur ne FY 18-19 ki ek case mein kaha ki supplier ki certification aur bill ki copy ITC prove karne ke liye kaafi nahi - proper documentation zaroori hai.
items.cga_view: Input credit lene se pehle, supplier se milne wale documents, invoices aur payment proof ache se sambhal ke rakhein. Sirf ek certificate pe bharosa na karein.

items.headline: Section 271C TDS penalty hataya, seller ne income disclose kar di thi
items.detail: ITAT Jodhpur ne TDS penalty isliye maaf ki, kyunki property bechne wale ne income ITR mein dikhayi aur Form 26A diya gaya tha.
items.cga_view: Property ki sale ya purchase mein TDS lapse ho jaye toh, Form 26A directly file karwa dein. Seller se confirmation lein ki usne income show ki hai.

items.headline: GST OIO aur DRC-07 mein difference: Rectification possible hai
items.detail: Allahabad HC ne kaha ki agar GST Order-in-Original aur DRC-07 form mein koi discrepancy ho, toh usko Section 161 ke tahat rectification kiya ja sakta hai.
items.cga_view: Agar GST order aur DRC-07 mein figures match nahi kar rahein, Section 161 ka reference de kar rectification jarur file karein.

items.headline: GSTR-3B Sept 2026 filing ki due dates aayi
items.detail: Trade reports ke mutabik, September 2026 ki GSTR-3B ki due dates: 20, 22, 24 October group ke hisaab se hongi. Filing se pehle ITC reconciliation, cash payment aur late-filing risks zarur check karein.
items.cga_view: Apne state ka group check karo, apna ITC 2B match karo, aur 20 October ke pehle filing planning karo. Deadline miss hui to interest/late fee lag sakta hai.

items.headline: E-way bill expiry pe direct penalty valid nahi
items.detail: GSTAT Lucknow ne penalty sirf e-way bill expiry pe hata di, kyunki koi dusra proof nahi tha ki tax evasion tha.
items.cga_view: E-way bill expire ho jaye to, jab tak koi aur solid evasion ka proof na ho, aapko badi penalty se bach sakte ho. But, movement ka proof zarur sambhal ke rakhein.

items.headline: ITAT Guwahati: ₹5.68cr cash penalty quashed
items.detail: ITAT Guwahati ne Section 271DA ka cash penalty hataya, kyunki limitation aur cash receipt ka proper proof nahi tha.
items.cga_view: Agar aap par bhi high value cash transaction ki penalty lagi hai, toh order ki copy lawyer/CA ko dikhao – proper documentation important hai.

items.headline: Resort construction pe ITC allowed nahi
items.detail: GSTAT ka kehna hai ki jo building, jaise resort, apne business ke liye banaye gaye hain, un par construction related ITC nahi milega (Section 17(5)(d)).
items.cga_view: Hotel/Resort bana rahe ho, toh construction ke ITC ki ummeed mat rakho – planning stage pe hi cost accordingly set karo.

items.headline: No proof of GST SCN service? Demand order set aside
items.detail: Karnataka HC ne GST demand hatayi kyunki department nahi dikha paya ki SCN sahi tarah serve hua. Portal, RPAD ya email se service prove nahi hui toh demand khatam.
items.cga_view: Agar ex parte demand aa jaye, toh sabse pehle SCN ki service ka proof mangwayen – bina proper service ke order tik nahi sakta.

items.headline: GST Demand can't exceed Show Cause Notice: Madras HC
items.detail: Madras HC ne bola ki GST department notice mein jo demand dikhai gayi hai, usse zyada demand fresh proceedings ke bina nahi ki ja sakti. Assessment ko reconsider karne order diya gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke khilaaf GST demand notice aaye, toh ensure karein ki final order notice se zyada demand na kare. Notice aur assessment carefully cross-check karein.

items.headline: ₹18 Lakh GST Penalty Set Aside: Allahabad HC
items.detail: Allahabad HC ne ₹18.15 lakh penalty hata di, kyunki department ne ownership docs ignore kiye. CBIC circular ke hisab se case dubara dekha jayega.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka vehicle detention ya penalty matter hai, to proper documents present karein aur circulars cite karein. Right legal grounds pe appeal karein.

items.headline: No Section 14A Disallowance Before Finance Act 2022: ITAT
items.detail: ITAT ne Section 14A ka disallowance (₹61 lakh) hata diya kyunki wo Finance Act 2022 ke Explanation se pehle applicable nahi tha.
items.cga_view: Aapka assessment purana hai toh sec 14A disallowance ka check karein. Agar Explanation new law ke baad hi effect mein aaya, toh relief mil sakta hai.

items.headline: TDRs on Land Surrender liable to Capital Gains: ITAT
items.detail: ITAT ne bola ki land surrender pe milne wale development rights (TDR) bechte time aapko Capital Gains tax dena padega. Acquisition cost allowable hogi.
items.cga_view: Land surrender karne par TDRs milte hain toh sale pe capital gains compute karte waqt unki cost dhang se document karein.

items.headline: Zee Group pe ₹2 Cr Penalty: Accommodation Entries
items.detail: ITAT ne Zee Group entity ki penalty uphold ki, kyunki depreciation/accommodation entries bogus mane gaye, survey mein issue pakda gaya tha.
items.cga_view: Aapke accounts mein accommodation entries ya suspicious depreciation/amortisation claims na ho. Department strict action le raha hai.

digests.summary: Aaj GST aur Income Tax pe kuch important court rulings aur compliance issues report hue hain. Saari info latest trade press par based hai, abhi tak koi official notification nahi aayi hai.

items.headline: GST Council Meeting par key reforms discuss hue
items.detail: 57th GST Council ki meeting mein GST registration, ITC, refund, arrest powers aur enforcement related proposals discuss hue. Abhi ye sirf trade reports hain, koi official circular ya notification nahi aaya hai.
items.cga_view: Abhi changes lagu nahi huye. Official notification ka intezaar karein, koi process ya system tab badlein jab notification aayega.

items.headline: GST Appeals: Time Limit aur Pre-Deposit ki practical baatein
items.detail: Section 107 ke under GST appeals file karte time 3 mahine ki limit, APL-01 filing aur 10% pre-deposit ka mention hai. Trade press ne practical challenges aur taxpayer rights pe highlight kiya hai.
items.cga_view: Agar appeal file karni hai to limitation deadline aur pre-deposit amount dhyan mein rakhein. Sahi documents ready karein aur grounds properly likhein.

items.headline: Time-barred reassessment notice quashed: Gujarat HC ka order
items.detail: Gujarat High Court ne Section 148 notice aur 148A(d) order (AY 2014-15) limitation ground par cancel kiya, Keenara Industries matter follow karte hue. Yeh High Court ka judgement hai, abhi notification nahi.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke against similar time-barred reassessment proceedings hai to apne consultant se discuss karke judicial remedy consider karein.

items.headline: Calcutta HC stays coercive action on GST demand
items.detail: Calcutta High Court ne ₹6.21 crore GST demand u/s 74 par coercive action stay kar diya, par main demand entertain nahi ki.
items.cga_view: Agar similar GST demand hai, to aapko bhi High Court stay ka legal option dekhna chahiye. Immediate payment se pehle legal advice lein.

digests.summary: Aaj ka digest GST aur Income Tax par kuch latest court rulings aur reforms cover karta hai. Official notification nahi aayi hai, toh council proposals aur court orders par focus hai.

items.headline: GSTAT ne ₹63.72 lakh penalty hatayi
items.detail: GSTAT Lucknow ne delayed e-invoice par section 129 ki ₹63.72 lakh ki penalty tab hata di jab invoice, e-way bill & transport docs sab the. Sirf late se e-invoice banne par penalty valid nahi mani gayi.
items.cga_view: Agar documents proper hain, to delayed e-invoicing cases mein penalty challenge kar sakte ho. Document record sambhalo.

items.headline: E-way bill reforms ke FAQs release hue
items.detail: FAQs ne bataya hai ki ab e-way bills ke interception aur detention ko restrict kiya ja raha hai. Jurisdictional powers, missing docs, confiscation ki details bhi di gayi hain.
items.cga_view: Transport mein unnecessary roko-toko se bache rehne ke liye FAQs padh lo aur proper documents ready rakho.

items.headline: IBC Moratorium ke dauran tax refund adjust nahi hoga
items.detail: NCLT Mumbai ne income tax refunds (₹1.7 crore & ₹2.69 crore) release karne ka order diya, insolvency cases mein IBC moratorium ke duran refund adjustment mana kiya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka business IBC process mein hai, to income tax refund direct lene ka claim rakho, tax dept ke adjustment pe objection file karo.

items.headline: Income tax refund set-off liquidation mein claim ke bina nahi
items.detail: NCLAT Delhi ne bola, liquidation ke samay income tax refund set-off tab hi hoga jab IT dept IBC ka claim procedure follow kare. Direct adjust nahi kar sakte.
items.cga_view: Liquidation cases mein, claim file kiye bina refund adjust nahi hoga, proper IBC process follow karwana hoga.

items.headline: Transfer pricing order bina sunwai ke quash
items.detail: Calcutta HC ne ek transfer pricing order sirf isliye khatam kar diya kyunki personal hearing aur adequate reason nahi diye the.
items.cga_view: Notice aaye to sunwai ke liye written request daalo; bina opportunity ke order pass ho toh challenge kar sakte ho.

digests.summary: Aaj ki digest mein GST Council ki nai recommendations aur Income Tax ITAT ki do rulings cover ki gayi hain. Abhi saari details official notification ka intezaar kar rahi hain.

items.headline: 57th GST Council: ITC, refunds, late fee waiver par proposals
items.detail: GST Council ne ITC, refund, arrest, e-invoicing, aur small taxpayers ke liye late fees waiver par kai recommendations diye hain. Abhi ye proposals official notification ka intezaar kar rahe hain.
items.cga_view: Filhaal koi step urgently na le – government notification aane par hi implementation hogi. Updates ka dhyan rakhein.

items.headline: ITAT Kolkata: Wrong officer reassessment order quashed
items.detail: ITAT Kolkata ne assessment ko quash kiya kyunki DCIT ka pecuniary jurisdiction nahi tha as per CBDT instruction.
items.cga_view: Agar assessment officer appointment disputed hai, toh uska reference CBDT instruction ke saath check karen; galat officer order pass kare toh appeal consider karen.

items.headline: ITAT Agra: SBI par TDS demand court protection ke chalte hatayi
items.detail: ITAT Agra ne seven SBI appeals allow kar di aur kaha ki Madras HC ke binding orders ke period mein TDS default nahi maana jayega.
items.cga_view: Agar kisi case mein court ka protection hai, toh relevant period ka TDS dispute legal precedent ke according evaluate karein. Documents ready rakhen.

digests.summary: Aaj kis digest mein GST Council ke kayi naye proposals aur recent court rulings ko highlight kiya gaya hai. Sabhi updates business owners ke liye relevant hai, compliance par dhyan dena zaroori hai.

items.headline: GST Council: Simplified Scheme for B2C Businesses Proposed
items.detail: GST Council ne propose kiya hai ki B2C businesses jinka turnover ₹5 crore tak hai, woh ek hi annual GST return file karein aur taxes quarterly pay karein. Abhi sirf proposal stage par hai, implementation details pending hain.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka turnover ₹5 crore ke andar hai, to news pe nazar rakhein. Scheme finalize ho jaye to compliance load kam ho sakta hai.

items.headline: GST Council: General Penalty Reduce Karne Ki Recommendation
items.detail: GST Council ne general penalty ko ₹25,000 se kam karke ₹10,000 karne ki recommendation di hai. Abhi apply nahi hui, official notification ka wait hai.
items.cga_view: Abhi koi action na lein, lekin penalty provisions mein mildness ane ki umeed hai. Official update aate hi review karein.

items.headline: GSTR-3B vs GSTR-2A Mismatch Pe Direct ITC Rejection Nahi
items.detail: GST Appellate Tribunal ne bola hai ki sirf GSTR-3B aur 2A ka mismatch hona ITC reject karne ke liye kaafi nahi hai. Verification, invoices, supplier records bhi dekhne zaroori hain.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka ITC mismatch notice aaye to sab documents ready rakhein aur CBIC Circular ke hisaab se verification ki demand karein.

items.headline: DCIT Assessment Without Jurisdiction Quashed: ITAT Kolkata
items.detail: ITAT Kolkata ne ek assessment ko khatam kar diya kyunki DCIT ne apni pecuniary limit se bahar assessment kiya tha. CBDT instructions ka violation hua hai.
items.cga_view: Agar department ne aapke case mein similar jurisdiction galti ki ho, to aap bhi appeal ya objection file kar sakte hain.

digests.summary: Aaj major GST aur Income Tax rulings par focus hai, mostly courts aur tribunals ne taxpayer ke favour mein kuch judgments diye hain. Official notification aaj koi nahi hai, sab news trade press se hai.

items.headline: Single GST SCN for Multiple Years Not Allowed: Kerala HC
items.detail: Kerala High Court ne composite GST notice (ek hi SCN) jo 2019-20 se 2023-24 tak kayi saalo ko cover karta tha, usko quash kar diya. Ab har saal ke liye alag notice jaari ho sakta hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko multi-year GST SCN mila hai, to apne consultant se check karva lo - shayad woh quash ho sake. Old notice par response dene se pehle legal check zaroor kara lo.

items.headline: Personal Hearing 'No' Option Nahi Chalti: Gujarat HC
items.detail: Gujarat HC ne bola ki agar aapne GST SCN me personal hearing 'No' bhi select kiya, to bhi Section 75(4) ke hisaab se authority ko sunwai ka mauka dena zaroori hai. Order quash hua.
items.cga_view: Aapne online GST reply mein personal hearing 'no' bhi select kiya ho, fir bhi aapko hearing ka haq hai. Agar bina hearing order pass hua ho, to appeal kar sakte ho.

items.headline: Same Officer ne Audit, SCN aur Order Diya, Order Set Aside: Karnataka HC
items.detail: Karnataka High Court ne wo GST order khatam kar diya jahan audit report banane wale officer ne SCN issue kiya aur adjudication bhi khud ki. Is tarah ka process correct nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke case me ek hi GST officer audit, SCN aur decision sab kuch kar raha hai, to turant objection file karo. Such orders court me challenge ho sakte hain.

items.headline: E-Way Bill: 50km tak Vehicle Details Part B mein Nahi Chahiye
items.detail: GSTAT ne bola ki agar consignment ka initial intra-State movement 50km se kam hai aur sirf transporter ke premises tak ja raha hai, to E-Way Bill Part B (vehicle details) dalna mandatory nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar local delivery (50km tak) transporter premises tak hai, to E-Way Bill mein vehicle number daalne ki tension nahi. Lekin onward movement pe zaroor fill karo.

items.headline: Section 271BA Penalty Invalid on Omitted Section 92BA(i): ITAT Chandigarh
items.detail: ITAT ne 271BA penalty ko invalidate kiya, kyunki penalty proceedings shuru hone tak Section 92BA(i) pehle hi delete ho chuka tha.
items.cga_view: TP transactions ke liye penalty aayi ho to dhyan rakho ki relevant section exist karta hai ya nahi. Agar section omission ke baad penalty lagi hai to appeal strong hai.

items.headline: Education Cess Claim – No Penalty if Bona Fide: ITAT
items.detail: ITAT ne bola ki agar aapne education cess ka claim purani judicial position ke basis par file kiya, to S. 270A penalty nahi lagegi, chahe baad mein law change ho gaya ho.
items.cga_view: Education cess par penalty ke notices aaye hain, to agar return file karte time law aapke favour mein tha to penalty nahi lag sakti. Proper representation kara lo.

digests.summary: Aaj GST council ka meeting postpone hua aur kuch important ITAT rulings aaye, mainly GST aur income tax par focus kiya gaya hai. Agle 10 din mein koi statutory due date confirm nahi hui hai.

items.headline: GST Council meeting 8 Oct ko Bharat Mandapam mein
items.detail: 57th GST Council meeting ab 8 October 2026 ko morning 11 baje se New Delhi, Bharat Mandapam mein hogi. Pehle yeh 7 October ko thi par ab postpone ho gayi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aap GST ke changes ya notifications ka intezaar kar rahe hain toh 8 October ke meeting ke baad hi koi naya update expect karein.

items.headline: GSTAT ne e-way bill expired aur galat vehicle par penalty sahi mani
items.detail: GSTAT Agra ne bola ki agar expired e-way bill mein alag vehicle number tha aur taxpayer ne proper jawab nahi diya toh Section 129 ke tahat penalty justified hai.
items.cga_view: E-way bill details har shipment pe sahi update karein; galat ya expired bill aaya toh penalty ka risk hai. Transit mein check zaroor karein.

items.headline: P&H HC ne retrospective GST cancellation ko quash kiya
items.detail: Punjab & Haryana High Court ne bola ki agar show cause notice mein pehle se retrospective cancellation nahi likha tha toh registration ke cancellation ko pichhle date se lagana galat hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko GST registration ka SCN mila hai toh check karein usmein kya likha hai, backdated cancellation nahi ho sakta bina proper notice ke.

items.headline: Sirf Form 26AS ki entry par full addition nahi ho sakta: ITAT
items.detail: ITAT ne kaha ki Form 26AS mein high amount dikhne par bhi agar actual paisa year-wise mila hai aur return mein dikhaya hai toh total consideration ek saal mein tax nahi ho sakta.
items.cga_view: Agar 26AS aur aapke received amount match nahi karte, toh proper documentation rakhein. Scrutiny aaye toh actual receipts zaroor explain karein.

items.headline: Section 148 notice bina enquiry ke valid nahi: Karnataka HC
items.detail: Karnataka HC ne reassessment ko quash kiya kyunki AO ne taxpayer ka explanation ya document properly examine nahi kiya tha.
items.cga_view: Section 148 notice aae toh har document timely file karein aur AO ke enquiry pe dhyaan dein; sahi records help karega.

items.headline: TDS nahi katega toh bhi penalty nahi jab seller tax de de: ITAT
items.detail: ITAT ne NRI buyer ki penalty hata di kyunki seller ne property sale ka tax khud pay kar diya aur Form 26A diya.
items.cga_view: Agar TDS galti se miss ho jaye toh seller se Form 26A le aayen aur ensure karein ki tax pay kiya gaya hai. Penalty se bach sakte hain.

digests.summary: Aaj kafi important GST aur Income Tax case rulings aayi hain, lekin aaj ke liye koi official notification ya due date nahi hai. Sab kuch trade press se hai, isliye implementation pe thoda wait karein.

items.headline: GST: Death ke baad bhi tax case legal rep se
items.detail: Delhi HC ne bola ki taxpayer ki death ke baad bhi GST ki proceedings uske legal representative ke khilaf ho sakti hain, lekin liability sirf estate tak hi rahegi.
items.cga_view: Agar kisi taxpayer ki death ho gayi hai, toh uske legal rep ko estate ka record achha rakhna hai – personal assets pe liability nahi aayegi.

items.headline: Income Tax Audit ki due date ab 21 Oct 2026
items.detail: CBDT ne audit report ki due date 21 October 2026 kar di hai, aur ITR ki 21 November 2026. Relief mainly audit wale taxpayers ko hai. (Ye trade source hai, official notice ka intezaar karein.)
items.cga_view: Audit clients ab extra time ka use kar sakein, lekin notification aane par check karein – tabhi final planning karein.

items.headline: 200% GST penalty e-way bill delay pe wrong: Cal HC
items.detail: Calcutta HC ne 200% penalty sirf e-way bill extend na karne pe galat mana, especially jab delay traffic ki wajah se tha. Refund bhi order ho gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar e-way bill technical fault ya traffic ki wajah se expire hua, toh penalty challenge ki ja sakti hai – documentation ready rakhein.

items.headline: TDS penalty cut to ₹10k/quarter: ITAT
items.detail: ITAT Lucknow ne Section 271H TDS penalty ₹1 lakh se ₹10,000 per quarter tak kam kar di, kyunki TDS deposit ho gaya tha, aur jyada penalty disproportionate thi.
items.cga_view: TDS late file hua ho lekin deposit bhi ho gaya ho toh penalty kam hone ka chance hai – ITAT order cite karein.

digests.summary: Aaj ke digest mein GST aur Income Tax ki kuch important compliance aur court rulings cover ki gayi hain. Sabhi updates trade press se hain, official notification pending hai.

items.headline: Additional GST Registration ab easy auto-filled details se
items.detail: Agar aap ek hi PAN pe naya GST registration lete ho, toh ab GSTN existing details auto-fill kar dega. Baar baar repeat entry ki zarurat nahi.
items.cga_view: Agar aap alag state ya branch ke liye registration le rahe hain, toh process ab quick ho jayega. Alert: final details submit karne se pehle check zarur karein.

items.headline: GSTAT: E-way bill pe 9 minute delay, penalty quash
items.detail: GSTAT Lucknow ne bola ki agar genuine transaction ho aur sirf 9 min ka delay ho E-way bill mein, toh sec 129 ka penalty valid nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka E-way bill thoda late bana aur consignment genuine thi, toh penalty ko challenge kiya ja sakta hai. Proof ready rakhein.

items.headline: Section 16(4) se mistakenly reversed ITC reclaim possible
items.detail: Agar ITC sahi time pe liya tha par clerical galti se reverse kar diya, toh Section 16(4) ki time limit reclaim pe apply nahi hogi; reclaim possible hai.
items.cga_view: Galti se reverse kiya ITC reclaim karna hai toh backup supporting ready rakho. Officer ko explanation dena padega.

items.headline: Limited Scrutiny ka scope cross nahi kar sakta AO: ITAT Delhi
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne bola ki AO limited scrutiny ka reason cross karke addition nahi kar sakta jab tak proper approval na ho.
items.cga_view: Aapke scrutiny notice mein agar specific point hai toh AO aur kuch add nahi kar sakta bina process follow kiye. Unnecessary addition ka response banao.

items.headline: Section 16(2)(c): ITC denial pe detailed guidelines (P&H HC)
items.detail: P&H High Court ne Section 16(2)(c) ke cases mein department ko 14 guidelines follow karne ko bola hai, jisse ITC denial mechanical na ho.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka ITC deny ho raha hai Section 16(2)(c) pe, toh ab guidelines ki copy officer se request karo aur detailed reply file karo.

digests.summary: Aaj ka digest key GST aur Income Tax rulings pe focused hai. Kaafi decisions business compliance ko affect kar sakte hain, especially transport, ITC aur refunds ke maamle mein.

items.headline: E-Invoice delay pe penalty tabhi jab tax evasion ho
items.detail: GSTAT ne bola ki sirf e-invoice na banane pe, bina tax evasion ke evidence ke, Section 129 penalty nahi lag sakti. Agar transaction genuine hai to penalty justified nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar e-invoice procedure miss ho gayi hai, lekin saara documentation sahi hai aur koi tax evasion nahi hai, to penalty defend ki ja sakti hai. Transport records sambhal ke rakho.

items.headline: E-Way Bill Part-B na bharne pe bhi penalty nahi jab tak evasion nahi
items.detail: GSTAT ka decision hai ki part-B update na karne se penalty nahi lag sakti jab tak transaction genuine hai aur tax evasion ka koi proof nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar sirf procedural lapse hua hai, toh penalty se bachav ho sakta hai jab tak documentation aur movement proper ho. Transport praman sahi rakkho.

items.headline: FORM GST MOV-09 mandatory hai, bina iss ke Section 129 penalty invalid
items.detail: GSTAT ne kaha ki Section 129(3) ke tahat final order sirf FORM GST MOV-09 me hi ho sakta hai. Agar yeh missing hai to penalty proceedings khatam maani jayengi.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko Section 129 notice mila hai par MOV-09 order nahi diya gaya, toh penalty ke order ko challenge kiya ja sakta hai. Notice aur orders carefully verify karo.

items.headline: Wrong assessment year me TDS credit allow nahi: ITAT Ahmedabad
items.detail: Agar aapne galat year me TDS credit claim kiya hai toh ITAT ne us par dene se mana kar diya, chahe previous year ka refund claim abhi pending ho.
items.cga_view: TDS credit sahi assessment year mein match karo. Galat year mein claim kiya toh abhi bhi time hai previous year ka refund file karne ka.

items.headline: Sole GST S.74A proceedings S.61 scrutiny ke bina bhi ho sakti hain
items.detail: Allahabad HC ne bola ki section 61 scrutiny mandatory nahi hai S.74A ki proceedings shuru karne ke liye. Department ke pass directly 74A lagane ka right hai.
items.cga_view: GST me agar aapko S.74A ki notice aaye aur S.61 scrutiny nahi hui ho, toh bhi uska jawab tayyar karo. Delay expect mat karo.

items.headline: GSTR-9/9C mistake se valid ITC khatam nahi hota: GSTAT
items.detail: Agar aapne annual return ya reconciliation me galati se galat ITC dikhaya hai, fir bhi jo ITC GSTR-3B me properly claim hua hai, woh aapka valid rahega. GSTAT ne yeh clarify kiya hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne annual return me ITC galat report kiya hai to turant correction ke liye approach karein, lekin panic na karein agar GSTR-3B sahi hai.

items.headline: Common supplier se hi case bar nahi lagta: Delhi HC
items.detail: Delhi HC ne clarify kiya ki CGST/SGST ke proceedings me sirf common supplier ya ITC ground se same subject matter ka bar nahi lagta unless tax liability same ho.
items.cga_view: Agar aap par dual proceedings ho rahe hain, to check karo ki kya exact same tax liability involved hai ya nahi. Defence accordingly design karo.

items.headline: GST refund rok sakte hain jab investigation/chori ka shak ho: Delhi HC
items.detail: Delhi HC kehta hai ki refund Section 54(11) ke tahat rok sakte hain, bina pending appeal ke, agar authority ko lagta hai ki fraud hua hai ya revenue at risk hai.
items.cga_view: GST refund pe investigation chal rahi hai toh release expect mat karo. Supporting evidence strong rakho aur follow-up bana ke rakho.

digests.summary: Aaj ke digest mein GST aur Income Tax se judi kuch important court rulings aur compliance points cover kiye gaye hain. Saare items recent developments par based hain, mostly courts aur tribunals ke orders.

items.headline: ₹2 crore GST appeal limit Supreme Court ne clarify kiya
items.detail: Supreme Court ne bola ki CBIC ki ₹2 crore monetary limit ab pending departmental appeals par bhi lagu hogi. Is wajah se ₹25.47 lakh tak ke appeals ab entertain nahi hongi.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka matter ₹2 crore ke limit se kam hai to ab pendency ka stress mat lo, department ki appeal likely close ho jayegi. Apne pending litigation ka status check karein.

items.headline: GSTR-3B aur 2A fark se hi ITC reject nahi hoga: GSTAT
items.detail: GSTAT Lucknow ne bola ki sirf GSTR-3B aur GSTR-2A mismatch dekh kar ITC ko ineligible nahi bola ja sakta. Department ko supplier certificate, RCM credit, aur reconciliation check karna hoga.
items.cga_view: Aapko apne ITC mismatch ka proper reconciliation aur supporting documents ready rakhne chahiye; yahi ab department me accept karwana hoga.

items.headline: Unreconciled GSTR-9C turnover par interest income exemption nahi milega
items.detail: GSTAT ne clear kiya ki sirf CA ka certificate ya audit report kaafi nahi hai, GSTR-9C turnover agar match nahi karta toh GST exemption on interest income reject ho sakta hai.
items.cga_view: Interest income exemption ke liye har supporting document, especially turnover reconciliation, complete rakhna zaruri hai. CA certificate alone ab sufficient nahi hai.

items.headline: Maharashtra mein GST authorisation par ₹500 stamp duty lagegi
items.detail: Maharashtra GST ke liye jo bhi CA, CMA, GSTP, relative ya employee ko authorise karte hain, unke letter par ab ₹500 stamp duty deni hogi; advocates ke liye court fee applicable hai.
items.cga_view: Business owners Maharashtra mein koi GST representation dena hai toh yaad rakhein, ab se ₹500 stamp duty applicable hogi. Documentation sahi rakhna hai.

items.headline: ITAT: Sale value pe S.50C nahi, agar pehle fix hua ho
items.detail: ITAT Chennai ne Section 50C ka addition hata diya kyunki property ka sale consideration registration se pehle hi fix ho gaya tha, aur uska evidence diya gaya tha.
items.cga_view: Property sale karte waqt agreement aur payment evidence sambhal ke rakhein, khas kar agar transaction pre-registration fix hua ho.

items.headline: ITAT Mumbai: SBI ko TDS default nahi maana; HC order follow kiya
items.detail: Mumbai ITAT ne SBI ko LFC TDS ke mamle mein default nahi maana, kyunki High Court ke binding order par hi action hua tha.
items.cga_view: Agar kisi payment par court ka order hai to TDS default ka risk kam hai, lekin har baar court ka written direction document mein sambhal ke rakhein.

digests.summary: Aaj ke din GST, Income Tax aur MCA se judi kuch important court rulings aur compliance updates aaayi hain. Official release koi nahi hai, par kaafi useful case laws aur penalty orders recent trade press mein aaye hain.

items.headline: GST Demand Show Cause Notice Se Zyada Nahi Ho Sakta
items.detail: Calcutta High Court ne decision diya ki GST demand, show cause notice mein jo amount hai usse exceed nahi kar sakta. Isliye department ko fresh hearing deni hogi, usse pehle 10% tax deposit karna padega.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko department ne zyada demand diya hai to yeh ruling ka reference de kar appeal/objection file karein.

items.headline: Pen Drive Entries Bin Proof Se Addition Nahi Banega
items.detail: ITAT Chennai ne section 153C ki proceeding quash kar di, kyunki pen-drive data ka koi corroborating evidence nahi tha. Sirf third-party entries par addition sustain nahi hua.
items.cga_view: Agar assessment sirf seized entries par ho raha hai toh aap supporting documents ki demand kar sakte hain.

items.headline: Company Secretary Appointment Mein Delay Par Rs. 15 Lakh Penalty
items.detail: Company ko 1,527 din late company secretary appoint karne par Rs. 15 lakh ka penalty laga hai, aur CFO aur director par bhi action hua hai. MCA ne Companies Act, 2013 ke section 203(1) ke breach par yeh penalty di hai.
items.cga_view: Jo bhi company secretary appoint karne ke liable hain, woh appointment timely karein. Delay se heavy penalty ho sakti hai.

digests.summary: Aaj ke digest mein GST court decisions, Income Tax ke ITAT rulings, aur NCLT ka ek important order cover kiya gaya hai. Sab updates compliance ya litigation se jude hain, business owners aur accountants dono ko practical implications samajh aayenge.

items.headline: Section 74 GST Demand Invalid Without Show Cause Notice
items.detail: GSTAT Kolkata ne bola ki agar GST Section 74 ke demand notice ke liye mandatory Show Cause Notice (SCN) issue nahi hota, to poori demand void hai. Sirf hearing ya communication SCN ka substitute nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko GST demand bina SCN mila hai, to uske khilaaf turant legal remedy consider karo. Bina SCN action null ho sakta hai—document sambhal ke rakho.

items.headline: Mere Form 26AS & ITR Difference Par Addition Nahi Banegi
items.detail: ITAT ne bola ki agar Form 26AS aur ITR mein salary numbers alag hain, sirf isi base par addition nahi ki ja sakti jab tak Form 16 se exempt components samjha diya gaya ho.
items.cga_view: Salary details ko Form 16, 26AS, aur ITR me match karao. Agar difference hai to CA se explanation prepare kara lo, unnecessary demand se bachne ke liye.

items.headline: GST Proceeding Bar Sirf Same Matter Pe Lagti Hai: Delhi HC
items.detail: Delhi High Court ne clarify kiya ki Section 6(2)(b) CGST ki bar sirf tab apply hoti hai jab dono parallel proceedings exactly same subject matter pe ho. Sirf same taxpayer hone se bar nahi lagegi.
items.cga_view: Agar aap pe kayi GST authorities se notices aaye hain, subject matter cross-check karo. Complete overlap na ho to proceedings challenge karna tough hoga.

items.headline: ITR Delay Condone Ho Sakta Hai Genuine Medical Urgency Mein
items.detail: Karnataka HC ne decide kiya ki wife ki pregnancy-related emergency ek valid ground hai ITR late filing ki condonation ke liye.
items.cga_view: Agar genuine medical emergency thi toh delay application file karte waqt proofs attach karo. Medical records bhejna mat bhoolo.

items.headline: Income Tax Refund Pre-CIRP Dues Pe Adjust Nahi Ho Sakta: NCLT
items.detail: NCLT Ahmedabad ne bola ki IBC moratorium (Section 14) ke dauraan income tax refund ko pre-CIRP dues adjust karna allowed nahi hai, adjustment set aside ho gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar company CIRP mein hai toh refund adjustment ka objection zarur file karo. CIRP companies ke liye direct cash inflow ho sakta hai.

digests.summary: Aaj mostly High Court aur ITAT ke GST/Incometax decisions aaye hain. Koi nayi deadline nahi hai, lekin compliance aur notices pe kaafi focus hai.

items.headline: GST interest allowed, TDS interest disallowed: ITAT Indore
items.detail: ITAT Indore ne GST pe interest allow kiya compensatory nature samajh ke, lekin delayed TDS interest disallow kar diya. Travel expense add back bhi delete ho gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke case mein GST interest ya TDS delay issue hai, toh apna calculation recent judgments ke hisaab se check karlo. Notice aane par proper reply tayyar rakho.

items.headline: ITAT: Section 11 claim re-examined due to ITR-7 error
items.detail: ITAT Rajkot ne ek trust ke Section 11 exemption claim ko wapas Assessing Officer ko bheja, kyunki ITR-7 mein galati thi. Officer ko ab fresh verify karna hai.
items.cga_view: Trusts apna ITR dhyan se file karein aur galti ho toh rectification karva lein; AO se follow-up zaroor karein.

items.headline: Form 10-IC lapse ke bawajood 115BAA benefit possible: ITAT Mumbai
items.detail: ITAT Mumbai bola ki agar Form 10-IC file karne mein procedural lapse hua, toh bhi Section 115BAA ka 22% tax rate consider ho sakta hai. Fresh chance diya.
items.cga_view: Agar Form 10-IC filing miss kar di ho, toh abhi application ya rectification karne ki koshish karein. Kaam time pe karein, CA se consult karein.

items.headline: 1 din delay se GST detention penalty void: J&K HC
items.detail: J&K High Court ne ruling di hai ki agar Section 129(3) notice time se na mile, toh poora penalty proceeding hi khatam ho sakta hai. Yaha ek din delay hua tha.
items.cga_view: GST detention ya penalty case mein notice ki date aur procedure verify karo; delay milta hai toh HC order ka reference de sakte ho.

items.headline: Gujarat HC: Analysis na ho paaye toh GST demand action nahi
items.detail: Gujarat HC ne interim relief diya kyunki GST e-way bill/invoice bohot zyada the aur analysis na ho paaya. Section 74 ka demand ruk gaya hai filhal.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka GST demand bohot high volume data pe hai toh court mein interim protection mil sakti hai. Proper documentation ready rakhein.

items.headline: Delayed GST refund interest: Authority se pehle approach karein
items.detail: Himachal Pradesh HC ne bola ki agar refund pe interest chahiye toh pehle GST authority ko application de. 60 din mein order aana chahiye.
items.cga_view: Interest ke liye pehle proper application likhein aur department ko dein. Record sambhaal ke rakhein, 60 din ke andar response expect karein.

digests.summary: Aaj ki digest mein GST aur income tax ke kuch important court rulings hai. Sabhi khabrein trade press par aayi hain, official notification ka intezaar hai.

items.headline: Gujarat HC ne income tax reassessment quash ki
items.detail: Gujarat High Court ne 2022-23 ka reassessment isliye khatam kiya kyunki ₹17.54 crore TDS deduction ka claim kiya hi nahi gaya tha. Department sirf tax audit report ko galat samajh gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka case similar hai jahan audit report pe basis banakar reopening hui hai, toh legal advice lein aur challenge karne par focus karein.

items.headline: GST Portal par supplier-recipient communication facility active

items.headline: Bombay HC ne 3 saal ke GST notice ko quash kiya
items.detail: Bombay High Court ne ek show cause notice, jo ek sath 3 financial years cover kar raha tha, khatam kar diya. Department ko naya notice issue karne ki permission di hai, jo law ke hisab se ho.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko bhi ek hi notice mein multiple years ke GST demand aayi ho, toh legal position check karein. Ho sakta hai notice invalid ho.

items.headline: Telangana HC: GST registration cancellation appeal par delay condone
items.detail: Telangana High Court ne taxpayer ko 2 hafta diye ki woh GST cancellation order ke against appeal karein, delay condonation ke saath.
items.cga_view: Agar appeal filing deadline miss ho gayi hai toh turant application file karein. High Court se relief mil sakta hai, lekin wait na karein.

items.headline: ITAT Mumbai: Same issue pe phir se assessment nahi ho sakta
items.detail: ITAT Mumbai ne ₹9.68 crore ka income tax reassessment isliye khatam kiya kyunki wahi issue pehle hi section 263 proceeding mein check ho chuka tha.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka assessment ya reassessment pehle se discuss hua tha, toh usko repeat karne par legal remedy possible hai.

items.headline: Section 11 exemption: Registration baad mein milne par bhi allowed
items.detail: ITAT Bangalore ne decide kiya ki agar 12AB registration baad mein milti hai lekin AY cover ho jata hai, toh Section 11 exemption mil sakti hai. Filing se pehle registration mandatory nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Trusts ya NGOs jo return ke baad registration lete hain, exemption ka claim revalidate karein, especially jab AY covered ho.

items.headline: CBDT ne TDS rules change kiye for NR property deals
items.detail: CBDT ne Income-tax (Fifth Amendment) Rules, 2026 notify kiye hain, ab TDS ka process aur Forms 132 and 141 mein changes hue hain specifically for non-resident property transfers. Source: taxguru.in.
items.cga_view: Agar aap koi property deal me NR involved hai, to naye TDS rules aur forms check karo. Actual notification padho aur TDS compliance update karo.

items.headline: BookMyShow convenience fee par Section 194H TDS nahi lagega
items.detail: ITAT Bangalore ne bola BookMyShow ke convenience fee pe Section 194H TDS lagu nahi hota, theatre owner ko fayda diya gaya hai (AY 2018-19). Source: taxguru.in.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka business ticketing ya platform fee se related hai, to yeh ITAT order refer karo. Lekin yeh past AY (2018-19) ka case hai, future ke liye law follow karo.

items.headline: Section 153C proceedings bina proper satisfaction note invalid
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne Section 153C assessments quash ki, jab Assessing Officer ne proper satisfaction note nahi banaya. Seized material ka income par direct link dikhana zaroori hai. Source: taxguru.in.

items.headline: Form 10-IEA galti se file, ITR choice hi valid: ITAT
items.detail: ITAT Bangalore ne kaha, agar ITR mein new regime chuna hai aur galti se Form 10-IEA file ho gaya, to ITR ki choice hi valid mani jayegi. Inadvertent Form 10-IEA se regime change nahi hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne galti se Form 10-IEA bhar diya hai, lekin ITR mein new regime dikhaya hai, to tension na lein—ITAT ne taxpayer ke favour mein bola hai. But galat filing avoid karein, clear record rakkhein.

items.headline: Leave Encashment exemption limit ₹25 lakh tak allowed: ITAT Delhi
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne bola ki AY 2020-21 ke liye leave encashment par section 10(10AA) ke tahat ₹25 lakh tak exemption milegi, jo CBDT notification ke hisab se hai.
items.cga_view: Agar is saal leave encashment mila hai, to ₹25 lakh tak exemption claim kar sakte hain—proper calculation aur documents rakkhein. Apne client ki eligibility cross-check kar lein.

items.headline: GSTR-2A vs 3B ITC dispute fresh hearing ko bheja: GSTAT
items.detail: GSTAT ne ek ITC mismatch case mein old demand ko hata ke, fresh and reasoned order dene ka order diya hai. Matlab, mismatch ki situation mein fair chance milega.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka ITC ka claim GSTR-2A/3B mismatch ki wajah se fas gaya hai, to fresh hearing ka option hai. Apna reconciliation ready rakhein, sach aur paperwork saaf ho.

items.headline: Vehicle-weight mismatch par ₹4.1 lakh penalty: GSTAT
items.detail: GSTAT ne Section 129 ke tehat penalty uphold ki—actual vehicle aur e-way bill data mein difference tha. Penalty Rs 4.1 lakh lagi.
items.cga_view: E-way bill fill karte samay bahut dhyan rakhein—weight, vehicle number, sab accurately match hona chahiye. Galti pe badi penalty lag sakti hai.

items.headline: GST audit findings se direct recovery nahi: Bombay HC
items.detail: Bombay HC ne bola ki GST audit ka finding letter (ADT-02) sirf ek communication hai, usse direct recovery nahi ho sakti jab tak aage CGST action na ho.
items.cga_view: Agar audit ke baad aapko sirf ADT-02 mila hai, to turant paisa mat bhar dijiye; jab tak proper recovery process start na ho. Legal advice lein agar pressure aaye.

items.headline: GST registration revocation, tax aur return bharne par allowed: Uttarakhand HC
items.detail: Uttarakhand HC ne bola ki agar taxpayer ne tax, interest, penalty bhar diya hai aur sab returns file kar di hain, to GST registration revoke ho sakta hai.
items.cga_view: Agar registration cancel ho gaya tha aur sab dues aur return bhar diye hain, to turant revocation application file karein—court se relief milne ka signal hai.

items.headline: ITAT Kolkata ne TDS/TCS penalty maaf ki
items.detail: ITAT Kolkata ne penalty sections 271C/271CA cancel ki, kyunki assessee ne TDS-TCS ka bona fide belief show kiya aur Section 273B ke tahat 'reasonable cause' maana gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar genuine mistake ya bona fide galti ho TDS/TCS mein, to section 273B ka benefit claim kar sakte ho. Lekin pura documentation zaruri hai.

items.headline: Late Form 10B bhi chalega agar CPC process se pehle diya hai
items.detail: ITAT Chennai ne bola Form 10B audit report 33 din late di gayi thi, lekin return process hone se pehle submit ho gayi thi, isliye Section 11 exemption mil gaya.
items.cga_view: Form 10B late ho jaye to bhi agar return process hone se pehle file ho, exemption reject hone ka darr kam hai. Par har case ka fact important hai.

items.headline: Section 153C proceedings quashed by ITAT Delhi
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne Section 153C ke action ko cancel kiya kyunki AO ne nahi dikhaya ki jo material mila uska assessee ke total income pe direct impact hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka assessment 153C mein hai, check karein AO ne proper satisfaction record ki hai ya nahi. Weak satisfaction note pe order quash ho sakta hai.

items.headline: GST appeal allowed as consultant didn't inform
items.detail: Telangana HC ne taxpayer ko GST Section 73 order pe 2 hafte mein appeal file karne ka mauka diya, kyunki consultant ne right time pe order inform nahi kiya tha.
items.cga_view: Agar consultant ki wajah se appeal miss ho gayi ho to abhi bhi court mein condonation ke liye chance mil sakta hai. Jaldi action lein.

items.headline: CBDT can't add cut-off in settlement cases: Rajasthan HC
items.detail: Rajasthan HC ne CBDT ke eligibility cut-off ko strike down kiya, bola ki interim board ko settlement applications merit pe decide karni chahiye.
items.cga_view: Agar aapki settlement application pe eligibility cut-off ka issue aa raha hai, to yeh ruling refer kar sakte hain. Final outcome Board ke merit assessment pe depend karega.

items.headline: Late e-verification par bhi Section 115BAC ka benefit
items.detail: ITAT Agra ne decide kiya ki agar return time pe file hui hai, par e-verification der se hua, to bhi naya tax regime (115BAC) ka benefit milega, CBDT Circular 10/2025 ke hisaab se.
items.cga_view: Agar verification late ho gayi hai, phir bhi Section 115BAC ka claim reject hua hai, to ye order ka reference dein. Purane reject cases bhi review kara lo.

items.headline: Section 148A(b) notice bina 7 clear din dene ke invalid
items.detail: ITAT Ranchi ne Section 148A(b) ka notice, reassessment aur Section 263 ki proceedings cancel kar di, kyunki proper 7 clear din nahi diye gaye the reply ke liye.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko ya client ko notice me 7 clear din nahi mile reply ka, to is ITAT Ranchi order ki copy laga kar defence bana sakte ho.

items.headline: Rule 31ACB ki procedural lapse se Section 40(a)(ia) ka disallowance nahi
items.detail: ITAT Bangalore ne decide kiya ki agar Form 26A produce ho gaya, to Rule 31ACB ki procedural galti ki wajah se Section 40(a)(ia) disallowance nahi ho sakta.
items.cga_view: TDS procedure me galati ho gayi hai, par Form 26A mil gaya to assessment me is ruling ka use karo. Disallowance se bach sakte ho.

items.detail: ITAT Agra ne kaha ki agar ITR time se file ho gayi thi lekin e-verification late hua, fir bhi Section 115BAC ka benefit diya jaa sakta hai, CBDT Circular No. 10/2025 ke reference ke saath.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka e-verification late ho gaya tha par ITR time pe file ki thi, section 115BAC preference reject hua to apne case ko ITAT Agra ya recent CBDT circular ke basis par reconsider karwa sakte ho.

items.headline: Calcutta HC condones delay on CGST Section 107(6) pre-deposit

items.headline: ITAT Nagpur quashes Section 271D penalty for want of AO satisfaction

items.headline: ITAT Bangalore remands Section 271(1)(c) penalty for fraud review
