items.detail: Andhra Pradesh High Court ne 4 saal ki composite GST assessment order ko set aside kiya, bola har saal alag notice aur proceeding honi chahiye.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko GST ka composite order mila hai jo multiple years cover karta hai, toh aap separate proceedings ki demand kar sakte ho.

digests.summary: Aaj mainly GST aur Income Tax compliance pe kuch important updates aur 2 latest court judgments aaye hain. Abhi sab trade press sources hain, toh final implementation dekhte raho.

items.headline: GSTN ne NIL demand orders pe appeal allow kiya
items.detail: GSTN portal ab Form GST APL-01 file karna allow karta hai, even agar demand order mein NIL/Zero amount dikha hai. Pehle restriction tha, abhatta diya gaya hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke upar nil demand ka order aaya ho aur aap challenge karna chahte ho, toh ab portal pe appeal daal sakte ho. Dhyan rahe ki actual order upload hua ho.

items.headline: Same GSTIN pe stock transfer: e-way bill na ho toh bhi penalty nahi
items.detail: Kerala GSTAT ne bola, agar same GSTIN ki branches ke beech stock transfer hua aur tax payable nahi hai toh Section 129 ki penalty nahi lagegi, chahe e-way bill bana ya nahi.
items.cga_view: Internal branch transfer pe penalty ka risk kam hua, par ye sirf Kerala ka order hai. Dusre states mein check kar lo ki local officer ka kya view hai.

items.headline: ITC rectification: Calcutta HC ne timeline extension allow kiya
items.detail: Calcutta High Court ne ruling diya ki ITC rectification ke liye Section 16(5) ke time limits ko government notification restrict nahi kar sakte. Taxpayer ka benefit decide kiya gaya.
items.cga_view: Agar ITC rectify/claim karne ka time miss hua hai toh ab legal option stronger hai, lekin abhi yeh sirf Calcutta HC jurisdiction mein directly apply hoga. National applicability ka wait karo.

digests.summary: Aaj GST aur Income Tax par mostly judicial updates aayi hain, compliance changes ki news nahi hai. Sab items trade press se hain.

items.headline: GST Penalty on Goods Without E-Way Bill: GSTAT Order
items.detail: GSTAT Lucknow ne Section 129(3) ke tahat bina E-Way Bill ke iron scrap le jaane par tax aur same amount ka penalty barkarar rakha hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aap goods transport karte hain, hamesha valid E-Way Bill banwayein, warna same amount ka penalty lag sakta hai.

items.headline: GSTR-3B aur GSTR-2A ITC Mismatch: GSTAT ne Dubara Verification Order Diya
items.detail: Bengaluru GSTAT ne FY 2018-19 ka ek ITC mismatch case invoice-wise fresh verification aur personal hearing ke liye dobara adjudication par bheja hai.
items.cga_view: Agar ITC mismatch ka notice aaye to har invoice ka record ready rakhein aur personal hearing miss na karein.

items.headline: Income Tax Refund: Pehle Interest, Baad Mein Principal Adjust Hoga
items.detail: Mumbai ITAT ne decide kiya hai ki Section 244A ke tahat income tax refund pehle interest dues se adjust hoga, uske baad principal tax se.
items.cga_view: Agar aap refund expect kar rahe hain aur interest mila hai, to pehle interest adjustment check karein, uske baad hi main tax refund aayega.

digests.summary: Aaj ka digest mostly ITAT aur High Court ke recent rulings pe based hai. GST aur Income Tax dono mein kuch important judgments aaye hain jo business owners ko check karne chahiye.

items.headline: Unsigned GST SCN/Order invalid: Rajasthan HC
items.detail: Rajasthan High Court ne bola ki unsigned GST notice ya order valid nahi hai. Digital ya physical signature, Rule 26(3) ke hisaab se mandatory hai.
items.cga_view: Agar apko koi unsigned GST notice mile toh turant is judgement ke basis pe usko challenge karein. Apne consultant ko dikhaen.

items.headline: Patna HC grants bail in GST evasion case
items.detail: Patna High Court ne ₹73.75 crore GST evasion case mein bail grant ki, jabki Section 69 aur 132 lagaye gaye the. Yeh arrest process ko lekar ek important order hai.
items.cga_view: Agar kisi pe GST evasion case chal raha hai ya arrest ka dar hai, toh is judgement ko lawyer ke saath discuss karein. Arrest ka process dhang se follow hona chahiye.

items.headline: Wrong ITR nahi bana double tax ka base: ITAT
items.detail: Chandigarh ITAT ne kahe ke galat ITR form se double taxation justify nahi hota. Same income pe do baar tax nahi lag sakta.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne galti se wrong ITR file ki, toh department agar same income pe do baar tax maang raha hai toh definitely appeal karein. Proof rakhein ki income disclose ho chuki hai.

items.headline: BSNL receipts pe incorrect addition: ITAT Chennai
items.detail: Chennai ITAT ne ruling di ki sirf Form 26AS dekh ke BSNL ki receipts ko commission nahi mana ja sakta.
items.cga_view: Agar tax department Form 26AS ki basis pe hi income ka nature badal raha hai, toh yeh judgement refer karein. Receipts ki actual nature explain karein.

items.headline: Section 56(2)(viib) not for genuine business acquisition
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne kaha ki jo shares business acquisition mein issue hue hain, unpe Section 56(2)(viib) nahi lagega. C L Educate Ltd ko relief mili.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne shares business acquisition mein issue kiye hain toh yeh order ek precedent hai. Tax planning mein yeh point consider karein.

items.headline: Form 26AS pe penalty: ITAT fresh hearing ka order
items.detail: ITAT Nagpur ne Section 270A penalty ko wapas fresh hearing ke liye bheja kyuki TDS calculation galat thi aur assessee ko pura suna nahi gaya tha.
items.cga_view: Penalty matter mein agar department ne sahi tareeke se suna nahi ya computation galat kiya hai, toh appeal mein zarur jaayein. Procedural lapses important hain.

digests.summary: Aaj courts ne GST aur Income Tax ke kuch major rulings diye hain, mostly specific cases par. Official govt notification aaj kisi bhi compliance area mein nahi aayi.

items.headline: Madras HC: GST Order On Deceased Quashed
items.detail: Madras High Court ne GST ka order, jo ek marhoom taxpayer ke naam pe tha, quash kar diya. Court ne bola, ab heirs ko sahi process follow karke notice dena hoga (Section 93, CGST Act).
items.cga_view: Agar business owner ki death ho gayi hai, toh heirs ko prepare rehna chahiye ki GST department notice bhej sakta hai. Proper legal advice lein.

items.headline: Kerala HC: ITC Denial Matter Dobara Dekha Jayega
items.detail: Kerala High Court ne ek taxpayer ka Jan-Mar 2019 ka ITC deny karna quash kiya. Court ne bola department ko dobara Section 16(5) ke hisaab se consider karna hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka bhi past period ka ITC deny hua hai, toh is judgment ka reference dena useful ho sakta hai appeal mein.

items.headline: ITAT: Diamond Grading Charges Pe TDS Nahin Lagega
items.detail: ITAT Mumbai aur Surat dono ne bola ki diamond grading/certification charges pe TDS nahi katega, kyunki yeh Fees for Technical Services mein nahi aata agar technical skill transfer nahi hota.
items.cga_view: Jewelry ya diamond business wale agar outside India se grading karwate hain, toh abhi aise services pe TDS na katega—lekin apne facts legal expert se check kar lein.

items.headline: Delhi ITAT: Payee Ne Tax Diya Toh TDS Ka Liability Nahi
items.detail: Delhi ITAT ne bola, agar jo party ko payment hui usne sahi tarah tax pay kar diya toh payer ki TDS default ki liability nahi banti. Yeh Section 201 ki proviso ko apply karta hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aap pe TDS short deduction ka notice aaya hai, toh payee ki filed ITR aur tax payment ka record zaroor dekh lein – yeh strong defence ban sakta hai.

items.headline: Delhi ITAT: Old Search Par New Satisfaction, 153C Assessment Quashed
items.detail: Delhi ITAT ne 153C assessment quash kiya kyunki 2023 mein satisfaction record hua, court ne direct kiya ki assessment sirf 147/148 ke tahat ho sakta hai.
items.cga_view: Agar recent case mein Section 153C ki notice mili ho toh is ruling ka reference assess kar sakte hain. Procedural ground pe relief mil sakta hai.

digests.summary: Aaj ke digest mein GST aur Income Tax ke kuch important court rulings hai jo compliance ko direct impact karenge. Business owners ko GST notices ke signature aur TDS property rules par dhyan dena zaroori hai.

items.headline: GST notice bina signature ke invalid: Rajasthan HC
items.detail: Rajasthan HC ne unsigned GST SCN aur demand order ko quash kar diya, bola digital/physical signature mandatory hai Rule 26(3) CGST Rules ke tahat.
items.cga_view: Aapko har GST notice ka sign check karna chahiye - bina sign/digital authentication wala notice invalid hai, aise mein turant legal help lo.

items.headline: GST default par BNS prosecution nahi ho sakta: Allahabad HC
items.detail: Allahabad HC ne clarify kiya ki GST/TDS deposit default par sida BNS mein prosecution nahi ho sakta jab tak koi alag criminal offence nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar sirf GST bhara nahi aur koi aur criminal charge nahi hai to aap par BNS ka prosecution direct nahi lagega. Lekin compliance regular rakhein.

items.headline: ITC challenge delay par Kerala HC ne appeal kharij ki
items.detail: Kerala HC ne ITC challenge reject kiya, kyunki taxpayer ne GSTR-3B/2A mismatch par remedy follow nahi ki aur delay bhi zyada tha.
items.cga_view: ITC dispute ho to sabhi GST notices timely respond karo aur records ready rakho, warna claim reject ho sakta hai.

items.headline: Joint property, har party ka ₹50L share se kam to TDS nahi
items.detail: Delhi ITAT ne hold kiya ki Section 194-IA TDS tab nahi lagega jab joint buyers ka individual share ₹50 lakh se kam ho, chahe combined value zyada ho.
items.cga_view: Joint property buy kar rahe ho to apne agreement mein individual share clearly mention karo. Agar aapka share ₹50 lakh se below hai, TDS ka issue nahi aayega.

items.headline: KPMG ko unbilled revenue write-off allow: ITAT Mumbai
items.detail: Mumbai ITAT ne KPMG ka unbilled revenue write-off maan liya aur Section 40(a)(i) TDS disallowance reject kar di. Yeh case AY 2015-16 ka hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke books mein unbilled revenue pending hai to similar facts mein write-off consider kar sakte ho, lekin detailed documentation ready rakhein.

digests.summary: Aaj mainly trade press se GST aur Income Tax ki kuch important updates aur court rulings aayi hain. Koi bhi official government release nahi, sirf trade reporting par hai; to business owners alert rahein, official notifications ka wait karein.

items.headline: Form 3CD mein naye reporting rules: FY 2025-26 se
items.detail: CBDT Notification No. 23/2025 ke mutabik, Form 3CD audit report mein April 2025 se kaafi updates aaye hain: presumptive taxation, MSME rules, loans, buybacks aur GST implications ka bhi reporting zaroori hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka audit lagta hai, apne auditor se naye Form 3CD requirement jaldi samajh lo. Data gathering abhi se shuru karo, warna last moment mein dikkat hogi.

items.headline: GST advisories: GSTAT, e-Way Bill aur mining sector
items.detail: July–August 2026 mein GST related departments—GSTAT benches, departmental appeal process, e-Way Bill rules aur mining sector enforcement pe updates aayi hain. Yeh sab advisories trade press mein aa rahi hain, official notification pending hai.
items.cga_view: GST kaam dekhne wala staff latest advisories dekhe; lekin koi major compliance tab update kare jab official notification aaye. Mining sector wale especially alert rahein.

items.headline: Deceased proprietor ke GST appeal par Andhra aur Orissa HC ruling
items.detail: Andhra Pradesh aur Orissa High Court ne GST proceedings ko quash kiya jab proprietor mar chuka tha. Courts ne bola ki legal heir pe fresh action ho sakta hai, Section 93 ke under.
items.cga_view: Agar kisi proprietor ke demise ke baad aap pe GST matter aaye, to legal opinion lo. Probate aur legal heir process clear rakho, old notices revert ho sakte hain.

digests.summary: Aaj GST aur Income Tax pe kai important rulings aayi hain, mostly ITAT aur tribunal level ki. Koi bhi official notification nahi hai.

items.headline: GSTAT ne 9-minute ki e-way bill lapse pe penalty hatayi
items.detail: GST Appellate Tribunal (GSTAT) ne Rs.2.63 lakh ki penalty cancel kar di, kyunki e-way bill sirf 9 minute late bana tha aur koi tax evasion nahi thi.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka e-way bill minor delay se bana hai, aur intention galat nahi thi, to penalty ka case tribunal mein challenge ho sakta hai.

items.headline: Section 234E late fee TDS returns par, June 2015 se pehle invalid
items.detail: ITAT Chennai ne kaha ki June 1, 2015 se pehle file hui TDS returns par Section 234E late fee nahi lag sakta.
items.cga_view: Agar June 2015 se pehle ki TDS return pe 234E late fee lagi hai to aap apni appeal file kar sakte hain.

items.headline: Reassessment dead ke naam par notice, void hai: ITAT Delhi
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne bola, agar deceased assessee ke naam reassessment notice diya gaya bina legal heir ko, to proceedings void hain.
items.cga_view: Agar family mein aise koi notice aaye hai to turant legal proof ke sath department ko inform karein, appeal ya objection laga sakte hain.

items.headline: Section 148 notice galat authority se, reassessment khatam: ITAT Vizag
items.detail: ITAT Visakhapatnam ne reassessment cancel ki, kyunki Section 148 notice JAO ne issue kiya jab ki FAO ki zarurat thi faceless mechanism mein.
items.cga_view: Aapke case mein agar notice galat authority se aaya hai to isi ground pe challenge kiya jaa sakta hai.

items.headline: Section 263 revision jab AO ne deposits dekh liye toh quash
items.detail: ITAT Agra ne Section 263 revision quash kiya, kyunki AO ne cash deposits pe pehle hi inquiry karke penalty proceedings shuru kar di thi.
items.cga_view: Agar similar case hai, toh Section 263 order ko challenge kar sakte hain agar AO ne sab examine kiya hai.

items.headline: GST notices ITC, turnover, RCM ke cases mein badh rahe
items.detail: Trade press bata raha hai ki ITC mismatch, turnover difference, RCM aur e-way bill issues pe GST department ne zyada notices bhejne start kiye hain.
items.cga_view: Aap apni GST returns, ITC reconciliation, aur RCM ki compliance ka double check karein. Official update ka wait bhi karein.

items.headline: Rajasthan HC ne ex-director ko GST fraud probe mein arrest se bachaya
items.detail: Rajasthan HC ne ex-director ki arrest par filhal stay diya hai par investigation allow ki hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aap pe bhi aisa legal pressure ho to interim protection ya anticipatory bail ke liye High Court jaen.

digests.summary: Aaj mostly income tax aur GST par kuch tribunal/court rulings update hue hain. Koi major government notification ya due date nahi aayi hai.

items.headline: 115BAC Benefit Allowed Despite Late Return: ITAT Delhi
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne belated return file karne par bhi Section 115BAC ka benefit allow kiya. Delay condone karke assessee ki nayi regime ki choice maani gayi.
items.cga_view: Agar client ka return late hai aur nayi regime choose karna hai, ab aise cases mein appeal ka option consider karo. Strict rejection zaroori nahi hai.

items.headline: Foreign Commission - Section 40(a)(i) Disallowance Deleted
items.detail: ITAT Ahmedabad ne ruling di ki foreign commission (bahar rendered services) par TDS ki zaroorat nahi thi, isliye disallowance hata diya.
items.cga_view: Agar koi foreign payment TDS par doubt ho (services India ke bahar diye gaye hain), toh similar precedent refer kar sakte ho.

items.headline: 148A Proceedings: Karnataka HC Ne Dubara Mauka Diya
items.detail: Karnataka HC ne reassessment, demand aur penalties quash karke taxpayer ko 148A(b) notice ka response dene ka fresh mauka diya, deadline 15 September 2026.
items.cga_view: 148A(b) ka notice aaye toh time par respond zaroor karo. Court ne recent order mein taxpayer ko ek aur opportunity di hai, deadlines ignore na karein.

items.headline: GSTAT: Deceased Proprietor Par GST Demand Set Aside
items.detail: GSTAT Thiruvananthapuram ne 2017-18 ke ITC par retrospective Section 16(5) lagate hue mrtak proprietor par GST demand hata di.
items.cga_view: Agar koi GST demand deceased proprietor ke naam par ho, toh is precedent ki copy department ko dikhao. ITC claim karne ka mauka hai.

items.headline: ITC Allowed to Bonafide Purchaser: Calcutta HC
items.detail: Calcutta HC ne bola invoice GSTR-2A mein reflect na hone par bhi agar aap bonafide ho toh ITC deny nahi kiya jaa sakta.
items.cga_view: Agar supplier ki GSTR-3B non-filing ki wajah se ITC atka hai, toh is HC judgement ka reference likh kar department ko reply bhejein.

digests.summary: Aaj mostly GST aur Income Tax par focus hai, mostly High Court aur tribunal ke updates hain. Direct compliance kaam abhi ke liye kam hai, par kuch important legal developments note karo.

items.headline: CBDT ne ITR-B introduce kiya Block Assessment ke liye
items.detail: CBDT ne ITR-B form launch kiya hai block assessment ke liye, Income-tax Rules, 2026 ke amendment se. Notification No. 97/2026 se Rule 332 update hua.
items.cga_view: Jo bhi clients ka block assessment chal raha ho, unke liye naya ITR-B form check karo. Filing process mein changes aa sakte hain.

items.headline: GST death ke baad legal heirs ki liability samjho
items.detail: Section 93 CGST Act ke hisaab se, taxpayer ki death ke baad GST liability legal representatives par aati hai, especially agar business continue ho raha hai ya estate se recover ho sakta hai.
items.cga_view: Agar client ki death hui ho aur business continue hai, toh legal heir ko GST liability ka dhyaan rakhna zaroori hai. Estate planning mein ab is point ko zaroor samjhao.

items.headline: Karnataka HC: GST seized goods bech sakte hain, proper notice ke baad
items.detail: Court ne GST authority ko allow kiya ki Section 129(6) KSGST/CGST Act ke tahat hazardous goods ko sell karein, agar owner appeal nahi karta. Notice serve karna compulsory hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke goods GST authority ne seize kiye hain aur appeal nahi file ki, toh goods bik sakte hain. Appeal ka option jaldi exercise karo, warna goods loss ho sakta hai.

items.headline: Delhi HC: GST SCN sirf portal par upload se valid nahi
items.detail: Delhi HC ne kaha ki agar GST show cause notice sirf portal par upload hua, proper serve nahi hua, toh poori proceedings wapas SCN stage par jayengi.
items.cga_view: Agar apko sirf portal par notice mila aur personally serve nahi hua, toh department ki action legally weak ho sakta hai. Is ground par relief mil sakti hai.

items.headline: Telangana HC: Cancelled GST registration ka revocation apply kar sakte hain
items.detail: Telangana HC ne allowed kiya ke agar GST registration fraud/suppression/alleged galti se cancel hua ho, toh taxpayer revocation request daal sakta hai.
items.cga_view: Agar registration cancel ho gaya hai, toh ab bhi revocation ka mauka mil sakta hai. Jaldi application file karo, especially agar cancellation reason dispute hai.

digests.summary: Aaj ke digest mein ITAT aur HC ke kuch important rulings aur GST notice ko lekar ek zabardast point highlight hua hai. Compliance aur notices handle karte waqt extra careful rahein.

items.headline: Unsigned GST Notice par Rajasthan HC ka ruling
items.detail: Rajasthan High Court ne bola ki sirf unsigned GST notice electronically generate hona legal authentication nahi hai. Aise notice pe recovery ya adjudication nahi ho sakta.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko unsigned GST notice milta hai to us par action lene se pehle legal review zaroor karayein. Unsigned notice valid nahi maana jayega.

items.headline: Trust ko TDS credit agar Form 26AS mismatch ho toh bhi
items.detail: Jodhpur ITAT ne trust ko TDS ka credit diya jab ki Form 26AS mein mismatch tha, kyunki trust ne income dikhayi thi aur Rule 37BA ki declaration sirf procedural hai.
items.cga_view: Agar trust ke Form 26AS mein TDS nahi dikha, lekin income offer ki gayi hai, toh claim reject hone pe aap ITAT ka yeh order use kar sakte hain.

items.headline: Manual Form 26A filing se TDS relief par koi rok nahi
items.detail: Jaipur ITAT ne kaha ki agar tax pehle se pay ho chuka hai, toh manually file ki gayi Form 26A bhi sufficient hai. Isliye ₹1.15 lakh TDS demand hata di gayi.
items.cga_view: Agar Form 26A online upload nahin hui par tax paid hai, toh manual filing case me bhi appeal ki possibility dekhein. Strictly procedural lapses pe relief mil sakta hai.

items.headline: Rs 60 lakh limit se ITAT mein reassessment par rok
items.detail: ITAT Bangalore ne ruling di ki agar tax effect ₹60 lakh se kam hai, toh reassessment issue pe dept ka appeal maintain nahin hota.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka case ITAT jaa raha hai aur tax effect limit se kam hai toh department ki appeal reject ho sakti hai. Appeal process monitor karein.

items.headline: Section 234C interest ka re-calculation allowed
items.detail: ITAT ne foreign-tax relief aur TDS credit lene ke baad section 234C interest ₹7 lakh se ghata ke ₹56,047 kar diya. Sirf net taxable shortfall pe hi interest.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko zyada interest notice aayi hai toh foreign tax credit aur TDS adjust karwa kar interest ka recomputation demand kar sakte hain.

items.headline: 25% tax rate agar turnover ₹400 crore se kam hai
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne rule kiya hai ki company ka turnover agar ₹400 crore se kam hai toh 25% tax lagega, 30% nahi, chahe CPC ne galti se zyada tax laga diya ho.
items.cga_view: Balance Sheet ke basis par hi apni company ke tax rate ka claim karein. CPC ka assessment galat ho toh turant rectification file karein.

digests.summary: Aaj ke digest mein GST, Income Tax aur TDS ke upar recent rulings discuss kiye gaye hain. Saare items trade press ke hain, koi official government release nahi aaya.

items.headline: Income Tax Data se Service Tax Limitation Extend nahi ho sakta: CESTAT
items.detail: CESTAT Chandigarh ne bola ki sirf third-party Income Tax data ke base par service tax demand zyada time ke liye lagana sahi nahi, jab tak suppression ka proof na ho.
items.cga_view: Agar department sirf kisi aur ki income tax info se purana service tax uthata hai, toh strong legal ground pe challenge ho sakta hai.

items.headline: SBI par Section 201 TDS Default nahi banta: ITAT Ahmedabad
items.detail: ITAT Ahmedabad ne decide kiya ki jab bank ne Madras HC ka interim order follow kiya, toh unpe LTC TDS non-deduction ka Section 201 default nahi lagega.
items.cga_view: Agar aap kisi court order ki wajah se TDS nahi kaat paaye hain, toh uski certified copy aur full compliance records sambhal ke rakhein.

items.headline: Same FY, same ITC issue se 'same subject matter' prove nahi hota: Delhi HC
items.detail: Delhi High Court ne GST ke overlapping proceedings ke mamle mein bola ki sirf same financial year aur ITC matter hone se Section 6(2)(b) apply nahi ho jaata. Appellate authority final decide karega.
items.cga_view: Agar aapki GST proceedings multiple forums pe chal rahi hain, toh specific facts ke liye appellate authority ka decision ka intezaar karein.

digests.summary: Aaj mostly ITAT ke rulings aaye hain, kuch TDS disputes par clarity mili hai. Court ne GST search payment refund par bhi comment diya hai.

items.headline: 500 pedh lagana Income Tax relief ka shart bana
items.detail: ITAT ne taxpayer ko 500 pedh lagane ki shart par apna case phir se Assessing Officer ko bheja. Yeh bhari addition (11.22 crore) se related hai.
items.cga_view: Agar apka koi appeal hai, toh court ki alag conditions aa sakti hain. Plantation jaisi rare order ko dhyan se padhein.

items.headline: 26AS mein TDS dikh raha toh spouse ke clubbing par mana nahi
items.detail: Kolkata ITAT ne bola – agar 26AS mein TDS diya hai toh TDS credit spouse ke clubbing se deny nahi hoga. Re-examine ka order diya gaya hai.
items.cga_view: Agar clubbing ki wajah se credit atka hai, toh AO se reconciliation jarur maang sakte hain.

items.headline: GST search payment refund pe Delhi HC ne action se pehle fact finding bola
items.detail: Delhi HC ne kaha ki GST search ke time agar zabardasti payment hua hai, toh fact finding jaruri hai. CBIC ke instructions bhi refer hue hain.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne search mein paisa diya hai aur refund chahiye, toh proper documentation sambhal ke rakhein.

items.headline: Reimbursement par proportionate TDS credit deny nahi ho sakta
items.detail: Mumbai ITAT ne bola reimbursement ke case mein books aur 26AS mein mismatch ho toh AO ko fir se check karna hoga, TDS credit deny nahi kiya ja sakta.
items.cga_view: Aapke books aur 26AS match nahi kar rahe toh AO se fresh reconciliation ki demand karo.

items.headline: Section 234E late fee nahi lagegi – June 2015 se pehle ke TDS returns pe
items.detail: Chennai ITAT ne Section 234E late fee ko invalid declare kiya un TDS returns par jo 1 June 2015 ke pehle process hue the.
items.cga_view: Agar aapki TDS return June 2015 se pehle ki hai, toh late fee ke liye ab appeal kar sakte ho.

digests.summary: Aaj major GST aur income tax court orders aaye, tax assessments aur penalties ko lekar clarity mili hai. Business owners in updates par dhyan dein.

items.headline: AP HC ne composite GST order ko set aside kiya
items.detail: Andhra Pradesh High Court ne ek hi GST order mein do saal (FY 2019-20 aur 2020-21) ko include karne wale order ko set aside kar diya. Ab alag tax period ka assessment alag se hoga, limitation period ka exclusion milega.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke against composite GST order hai, toh alag-alag period ke liye separate notices/appeals ka plan banaaein.

items.headline: Allahabad HC: GST penalty SCN se zyada nahi ho sakti
items.detail: Allahabad High Court ne us order ko khatam kiya jisme SCN (Show Cause Notice) ki demand se zyada penalty lagayi gayi thi, Section 75(7) ki violation ke wajah se.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke assessee ke saath bhi SCN ke beyond penalty lagi hai toh usko challenge karne ka ground mil sakta hai.

items.headline: ITAT Delhi: Bona fide ITR non-filing pe penalty delete
items.detail: ITAT Delhi ne ek case mein ₹3.74 lakh penalty Section 270A ki, non-filing pe, hata di jab assesee ne TDS aur income accept ki thi. Bona fide galti ki wajah se penalty valid nahi samjhi gayi.
items.cga_view: Agar TDS already deduct ho gaya aur income declare ki hui hai, toh non-filing pe penalty ko challenge kar sakte hain.

digests.summary: Aaj High Courts aur Tribunals se GST, Income Tax aur TDS pe kuch important rulings aayi hain. Compliance wale kaam mein thoda dhyaan dena zaroori hai.

items.headline: Madras HC: GSTR-1 galti ki rectification allowed
items.detail: Madras High Court ne FY 2017-18 ki inadvertent GSTR-1 errors ko rectify karne ki permission di. Court ne kaha software ki dikkat se correction mana nahi kiya ja sakta.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne galti se galat GSTR-1 file ki thi (bona fide mistake), toh rectify karne ki umeed hai. Apni case ki details check kar ke rectify request file karein.

items.headline: Rajasthan HC: 101 din GST appeal delay condoned
items.detail: Rajasthan High Court ne GST appeal me 101 din ki der ko maaf kar diya, aur Appellate Authority ko merit par decision lene ko kaha.
items.cga_view: Agar aapki GST appeal time limit ke baad bhi pending hai, toh aap bhi condonation ke liye try kar sakte hain, lekin sahi reason dikhaana zaroori hoga.

items.headline: ITAT Agra: Pura TDS credit ek co-owner ko mila
items.detail: ITAT Agra ne decide kiya ki jab baaki co-owners ne apna share claim nahi kiya toh pura TDS credit ek hi PAN (Tejpratap Singh Yadav) ko mil gaya.
items.cga_view: Joint property ya asset mein TDS credit distribute karna ho toh sab co-owners ko apna share claim karna chahiye. Claim nahi karoge toh ek bande ko pura benefit mil sakta hai.

items.headline: Bombay HC: Income tax refund pe extra interest possible
items.detail: Bombay HC ne AO ko bola ki delayed AY 2008-09 refund pe balance interest ka calculation karein, aur jo bhi banta ho four weeks mein de.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka refund delay hua hai toh interest calculation check karein. AO ko likh ke extra interest demand kar sakte ho, especially old refunds me.

items.headline: Karnataka HC: DRP directions ignore ki to assessment quash
items.detail: Karnataka High Court ne Flextronics ka assessment quash kiya kyunki Assessing Officer ne DRP ke binding directions ko ignore kiya tha.
items.cga_view: Agar DRP ke baad AO ne aapki baat nahi maani ya unke order follow nahi kiye, toh apna order review karwa sakte ho. Appeal ka strong ground hai.

digests.summary: Aaj Supreme Court ki GST SCN par kuch important rulings aayi hain aur Income Tax, TDS aur MCA par bhi kuch updates hai. In par hi focus karte hain.

items.headline: GST SCNs: Supreme Court ne fair hearing par zor diya
items.detail: Supreme Court keh rahi hai ki GST Show Cause Notice (SCN) mein allegations clear hone chahiye aur company ko properly apna side rakhne ka mauka milna chahiye. Pre-decided mind se proceedings chalana galat hai.
items.cga_view: Agar kisi tax officer ka GST SCN vague hai ya hearing fair nahi lag rahi, to legal advice lekar objection file karo. SC ki ruling aapke favour mein ho sakti hai.

items.headline: Mechanical fraud bolne se SCN ka limitation nahi badh sakta: SC
items.detail: Supreme Court ne decide kiya hai ki sirf 'fraud' bol dene se Section 74 CGST ka limitation period extend nahi hoga. Fraud ka specific evidence hona zaruri hai.
items.cga_view: Aapke khilaaf agar GST fraud ka vague allegation lag raha hai to limitation check karo, time-barred ho sakta hai. Legal recourse socho agar SCN illegal lage.

items.headline: Political/Charitable Donations par IT Notice?
items.detail: Recent income tax notices Section 80G aur 80GGC ki deductions claim karne walon ko aarahi hai. SMS/email advisories, scrutiny notices aur reassessment proceedings ho rahi hain.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko aisa notice aaya hai to saare donation receipts aur related documents ready rakho. Accountants ko bhi client verification pe focus karna chahiye.

items.headline: DIN update karne ka process: DIR-6 file karo
items.detail: Directors ko apne DIN mein koi bhi change aata hai, to 30 din ke andar MCA ko DIR-6 form se batana hota hai. Rule 12 ke hisab se ye mandatory hai.
items.cga_view: Business owners/directors agar DIN detail change ho toh delay na karein. Sab supporting documents ready rakhein aur DIR-6 jaldi file karein.

items.headline: TDS paid double nahi ho sakta; late payment par interest lagega
items.detail: ITAT Mumbai ne bola ki TDS ek hi baar recover ho sakta hai, lekin agar payment late kiya to interest zarur lagega. Doubled recovery ka scope nahi hai par timely payment zaruri hai.
items.cga_view: Agar department double TDS mang raha hai, to uska proof maangein. TDS timely deposit karen, nahi toh interest cost uthani padegi.

digests.summary: Aaj major service tax ke old matters pe tribunal ne relief diya hai. Income tax mein ITAT ne kuch routine disputes settle kiye hain.

items.headline: ST-3 aur 26AS/ITR mismatch par Service Tax demand set aside
items.detail: CESTAT Chandigarh ne ₹1.04 crore service tax demand ko hata diya, sirf ST-3 aur 26AS/ITR mismatch basis par demand sahi nahi mani gayi.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke khilaaf aise demand aayi hai to documentation pakka rakho aur tribunal relief ka reference de sakte ho.

items.headline: ITAT: ₹23 lakh deposit marriage ke liye, mangoes sale ka source accepted
items.detail: ITAT ne paisa deposit par documentary proof dekh kar source ko sale of trees and mangoes accept kiya aur addition delete ki.
items.cga_view: Aap agar cash ya large deposits explain karna chahte hain to proper document tayar rakhein jo source dikhaye.

items.headline: Section 12AB aur 80G approval par SC case ki conditionality hatayi
items.detail: ITAT Mumbai ne Section 12AB aur 80G registrations par CIT(E) ki Supreme Court pending case ki conditionality delete kar di.
items.cga_view: Agar aapka trust ki registration aise condition ke saath hai to ITAT ka yeh order aapke favor mein cite kiya ja sakta hai.

digests.summary: Aaj ke din kuch important GST aur court rulings aaye hain jo importers aur service providers ko dhyan me rakhni chahiye.

items.headline: GSTIN ya Fee Payment se Service Recipient prove nahi hota: AAR Rajasthan
items.detail: AAR Rajasthan ne bola ki sirf GSTIN ya fee payment se ye nahi maana ja sakta ki koi entity service recipient hai. Har case ki details alag ho sakti hain.
items.cga_view: Service contract details aur documentation tight rakho – sirf payment ya GSTIN pe rely mat karo.

items.headline: Delayed IGST on Imports ka Interest Refund nahi milega: CESTAT Delhi
items.detail: CESTAT Delhi ne decide kiya ki import pe jo delayed IGST ka interest hota hai, uska refund nahi mil sakta, agar assessment pe challenge nahi hua ho.
items.cga_view: IGST timely pay karo, interest refund expect mat karo; assessment pe time pe dispute uthao.

items.headline: IGST Demand Advance Authorisation Imports pe hata: CESTAT Ahmedabad
items.detail: CESTAT Ahmedabad ne Sakar Industries ka IGST demand set aside kar diya, bola pre-import condition factual basis pe fulfill hui thi.
items.cga_view: Agar aap advance authorisation ke under import karte ho, toh pre-import ki conditions ki file ready rakho – department se sawal ho toh proof dikhana pad sakta hai.

digests.summary: Aaj ke digest mein GST aur income tax se jude court rulings, aur TDS par ek CBDT explanation hai. Official notification ka intezaar abhi bhi hai, isliye har cheez ko last confirm na maane.

items.headline: IGST galat head mein hone par adjust ho sakta hai: Karnataka HC
items.detail: Karnataka High Court ne GST demand khatam ki aur bola ki agar IGST galat head mein pay hua hai, toh CGST/SGST liability ke against adjust ho sakta hai; ab fresh consideration hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar client se galat GST head mein payment ho gaya hai, toh department se adjustment ke liye proper representation karein, par official order dekhein, har state ka approach alag ho sakta hai.

items.headline: Delhi HC: SGST notice baad mein aane par CGST proceedings valid
items.detail: Delhi High Court ne decide kiya ki agar CGST proceedings pehle shuru ho gayi hai, toh baad mein SGST notice aane par bhi CGST action bar nahi hota.
items.cga_view: Parallel GST notices aaye hain toh confuse mat ho, dono alag chal sakte hain - reply har department ko timely de.

items.headline: AIS & TIS ka use, galat entry par feedback ka option
items.detail: Income Tax department ne AIS & TIS information aur taxpayer feedback process samjhaya hai. Feedback se ITR auto-pre-fill mein bhi help milegi.
items.cga_view: AIS/TIS portal check kar ke galat entry pe turant feedback dalein, taki ITR mein correct info jaye. Har client ka review karein.

items.headline: TDS on Non-resident payment: CBDT ki samjhayi hui guide
items.detail: CBDT ne ek brochure release kiya hai jisme non-residents ko payment par TDS kaise katega (section 195) aur lower/nil deduction certificate (section 197) ka process bataya gaya hai.
items.cga_view: Foreign payment plan ho toh latest CBDT material dekhein; lower/nil deduction ke liye timely application file karein.

items.headline: Madras HC: AY 2015-16 Section 148 notice allowed, limitation mein
items.detail: Madras High Court ne section 148A(d) ka order aur section 148 notice (AY 2015-16) ko sahi mana hai, yeh proceedings limitation period mein aayi thi.
items.cga_view: Agar old years ke liye 148 notice aayi ho toh High Court precedent check kar ke reply karein; challenge ka ground limited hai.

digests.summary: Aaj ka digest mein only court rulings hain, zyada tar GST aur income tax ke recent cases par. Official announcements nahi hain, sirf trade press se news hai, toh business owners abhi direct action na le, lekin apne cases aur notices ko check kar lein.

items.headline: SGST notice ke baad bhi pehle CGST case valid: Delhi HC
items.detail: Delhi HC ne bola ki agar CGST ki proceedings pehle shuru hui thi, toh baad mein aayi SGST notice se wo nullify nahi hoti. Section 6(2)(b) ka aisa koi bar nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke against pehle CGST aur baad mein SGST notice aya hai, toh dono ki validity check karen—sirf is base pe challenge na karein ki ek authority already action le chuki thi.

items.headline: GST refund delay pe interest milega, naya certificate nahi chahiye: Telangana HC
items.detail: Telangana HC ne bola ki agar refund pe interest claim karna hai aur refund already sanction ho chuka hai, toh dubara certification ki zarurat nahi.
items.cga_view: Agar GST refund aapko late mila hai, toh bina kisi extra document ke interest claim request karein. Bas sanctioned refund proof ready rakhein.

items.headline: ITR me galat exemption section bhara? Section 10(26AAB) benefit phir bhi mil sakta hai
items.detail: ITAT Lucknow ne bola ki agar taxpayer ne galat section me exemption claim kiya but eligible hai, toh AO ko sahi section dekh ke benefit dena chahiye.
items.cga_view: Agar aap ya aapka client galti se ITR me exemption ki galat section bhar deta hai, toh eligibility proof ke saath AO ke samne apni claim present karein.

digests.summary: Aaj ka digest mein key court rulings aur income tax ke practical points cover kiye gaye hain. Sab items high-impact aur relevant hain, trade press se liye gaye kyunki aaj official release nahi aayi.

items.headline: Arbitral Damages GST ke under taxable nahi: Bombay HC
items.detail: Bombay High Court ne bola ki arbitral award ka damages ya settlement GST supply nahi maana jayega. Matlab yeh compensation section 7 CGST Act ke andar taxable nahi hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapko business dispute mein damages mile hain toh GST ka liability ya return mein supply treat mat karo. Lekin similar disputes mein case facts check kar lo.

items.headline: TDR Exchange par capital gain lagega: ITAT ka decision
items.detail: ITAT ke according, agar aap existing land/building surrender karke TDR rights lete ho aur bechte ho, toh yeh transfer capital gain head mein taxable hai. Section 45 apply hoga.
items.cga_view: Agar aap TDR rights mein deal kar rahe ho toh capital gain calculation properly karo, supporting documents sambhal ke rakho. Surrender ka nature clear maintain karo.

items.headline: Sirf CBDT data pe Service Tax demand nahi chal sakta: CESTAT
items.detail: CESTAT Kolkata ne Service Tax demand set aside kar diya kyunki sirf CBDT/26AS data pe hi basis tha, independent verification nahi tha. Evidence aur due process ka hona zaroori hai.
items.cga_view: Agar aapke against only data-mismatch ki wajah se Service Tax demand aayi hai toh evidence aur proper procedure ki demand karo. Apne representation strong banao.

digests.summary: Aaj mostly GST aur Income Tax ke kuch important tribunal/court rulings aaye hain. Government ka koi new official circular nahi hai. Reporting mein clarity important hai.

items.headline: GST exclusion: ITAT ne Section 271B penalty hatai
items.detail: Mumbai ITAT ne kaha ki assessee ne apni turnover se GST hata, penalty nahi lagi kyunki uska yakin genuine tha. Yeh un logon par lagu hai jo GST ko tax audit turnover se exclude karte hain.
items.cga_view: Agar aapne GST ko exclude kiya aur penalty notice aayi, to ab tribunal ke is ruling ka reference de sakte hain. Par final view department pe depend karega.

items.headline: Bangalore ITAT: High-turnover comparables ALP mein exclude hue
items.detail: ITAT ne kuch high-turnover companies ko ALP se hata diya aur TDS credit bhi allow ki, as per Form 26AS. Transfer pricing matters mein relevant hai.
items.cga_view: ALP calculation mein agar comparables ka turnover bahut zyada hai, to aap bhi yeh reasoning try kar sakte hain. TDS credit galat show ho raha hai to ITAT order ka reference den.

items.headline: GST order ki sirf portal upload se appeal limitation start nahi hoti: Rajasthan HC
items.detail: Rajasthan High Court ne 645 din ki delay allow ki, bola proper service nahi hui thi toh sirf portal par order dalne se appeal ki limitation start nahi hoti.
items.cga_view: Agar order ki physical ya proper service nahi hui aur appeal ki time limit miss ho gayi hai, toh yeh HC ka decision helpfull ho sakta hai. Appeal file karte samay is order ka reference dein.
